## Company Description
Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.
Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.
We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.
Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.
We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime – from birth to old age.
## Job Description
We are hiring a Clinical Research Interface (CRI) Manager to provide coordination support and management of the CRI.
The CRI provides a critical link between the Research Network working with data available in the National Genomic Research Library, Genomics England and NHS clinical teams caring for patients.
The role will involve working with the relevant teams at Genomics England and external stakeholders to maximise the impact of genomic findings for participants and patients. This includes returning putative diagnostic findings to the NHS, initiating collaborations between researchers and NHS clinicians to further research and linking participants with potential therapeutic opportunities.
The Clinical Research Interface (CRI) team provides coordination and stakeholder engagement needed to support the return of important research findings into healthcare settings.
As CRI Manager, you will oversee the logistical processes required to support the Diagnostic Discovery pathway and facilitate research collaborations, bringing together researchers, clinicians, diagnostic laboratories, and internal teams.
You will play a key role in building strong partnerships, maintaining high standards of quality and compliance, and helping scientific discoveries make a meaningful difference in patient care.
**Everyday responsibilities include:**
* Manage the day-to-day operations of the Diagnostic Discovery pathway, for returning new candidate diagnoses identified to NHS laboratories.
* Manage the day-to-day operations for Clinical Collaboration requests, to facilitate and promote collaborations between researchers and clinicians.
* Liaise with members of the CRI team, Diagnostic Discovery team, and other Genomics England teams across healthcare and research services to resolve complex scenarios, achieve optimal end-to-end support for these workflows and align CRI activities with the wider service.
* Liaise with NHS clinicians and scientists and members of the Research Network to respond to queries and requests, resolve complex situations arising and seek feedback to enable improvements to the CRI pathways and processes.
* Managing consent verification, patient information checks, and laboratory identification to ensure findings can progress safely and compliantly.
* Maintaining tracking systems, reports, and operational documentation to support effective case management and governance.
* Building strong partnerships with researchers, clinicians, laboratory scientists, and other stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and decision-making.
* Ensuring robust governance processes are followed when handling sensitive patient information and research findings.
* Identifying opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and operational efficiency across the pathway.
**Skills & experience for success:**
* Extensive experience in healthcare, clinical research, life sciences or precision medicine.
* An understanding of genomics, genetics, or biological sciences.
* Experience supporting and developing team members.
* Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a complex stakeholder environment.
* Good understanding of health data, information governance, data privacy, and the management of sensitive patient information.
* Experience producing and maintaining accurate records, reports, and operational documentation.
* Confidence working with workflow, service management, or case management systems such as Jira, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
* Strong planning, process management, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

Master's degree (MSc) or equivalent professional experience.

OverviewApplication
We're hiring a hands-on Finance Manager to own day-to-day finance across a growing, multi-entity proptech group. You'll run the core finance engine which includes payroll, payments, reconciliations, month-end and statutory compliance. You’ll be tasked with improving it with automation so it can scale without extra headcount.
This is a broad role with real ownership. One day you might be closing out an audit, the next you're redesigning how customer refunds are paid or building a reconciliation that saves the team hours every week. The group spans UK and overseas entities, including subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Philippines and Dubai, and some products are FCA-regulated. You'll work closely with sales, support, property management and our external accountants and auditors.
**Key responsibilities:**
**Statutory accounts, audit and group reporting**
* Prepare trial balances and management accounts for each entity, including overseas subsidiaries, and support group consolidation under FRS 102.
* Handle intercompany balances, FX translation and acquisition accounting for new or restructured entities.
* Own the audit process: prepare PBC lists, answer auditor queries and manage the group and subsidiary audits from start to finish.
* Track Companies House filing deadlines, audit exemptions and accounting reference date changes so no entity falls overdue.
* Assist in the preparation of VAT returns, R&D tax credit claims and other statutoring filings such as PSA and P11D.
**Payroll and Benefits**
* Oversee monthly payroll and payslip queries with our external accountants
* Calculation and oversight of variable commission to the sales team
* Manage share scheme compliance, including EMI notifications and annual returns.
* Run employee expenses through Xero Expenses and keep the VAT treatment correct so input VAT is reclaimed.
**Payments, cash and reconciliations**
* Run weekly payment runs, including customer refunds and supplier payments
* Reconcile bank, Stripe and CRM data; resolve unmatched receipts
* Raise invoices to developers and customers, track and pay corresponding invoices to partners and agents.
* Oversee landlord rent collection and payouts for our L&M arm, including statements and discrepancy resolution.
* Manage credit control, including uncollectible invoices and failed subscription payments.
**Revenue and commercial controls**
* Reconcile deal revenue, agent fees and customer incentives in HubSpot against finance records.
* Own subscription billing policy in Stripe, including the approval process for discounts and fee waivers.
* Run spend analysis across vendors and flag cost trends
**Systems, process and special projects**
* Automate and document manual finance workflows (Slack, Google Sheets, Zapier, Count)
* Write and maintain finance guidance for the wider team, such as expenses and subscription policies.
**Financial Tool You’ll Use:**
* Xero
* Joiin
* Stripe
* HubSpot
* Count.io
* Google Sheets,
* Notion, and automation tools such as Zapier.
## **About You**
* CA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified (or qualified by experience), with 3+ years in finance, ideally including time in practice.
* Solid UK GAAP (FRS 102) knowledge, including consolidation and intercompany.
* Strong Excel skills: building clean, formula-driven reconciliations and models others can follow.
* Confident working with large datasets from multiple sources (bank exports, Stripe, CRM): cleaning and joining them, spotting patterns and anomalies, and turning them into clear insights.
* Clear, concise communication with non-finance colleagues, and comfort working in a fast-moving startup.
* A process-improvement mindset. you question how things are done, document what you build, and use AI and automation to make finance work faster and more accurate.

* Real scope - you’ll sit close to leadership, your work directly supports the company’s growth
* Build, don't just maintain. We run on modern tools and actively use automation and AI, and we want you to push that further.
* Close collaboration with Sales, Operations, People and our product teams

You will move beyond "assigned work" to actively improve the quality, reliability, and performance of our systems. You will work across product, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security boundaries, making sound architectural trade-offs, communicating complex ideas clearly in an asynchronous environment, and helping define the standards for a high-scale, global product.

* **High Impact:** You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the architecture of a global platform used by millions.
* **Technical Agency:** You will influence team objectives, technical direction, and long-range goals, helping us solve problems of high scope and complexity.
* **Innovative Culture:** You will get to experiment with and integrate agentic AI into production engineering workflows, moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build resilient, AI-assisted systems.
* **Autonomy:** You will thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
* **User-Centric Collaboration:** You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, ensuring every technical decision delivers genuine value to our users.

* **Drive Technical Direction:** Design and ship moderate to complex backend features with minimal guidance, making pragmatic choices between modular-monolith code, shared components, or independently operated services.

* **Operational Excellence:** Diagnose and prevent performance/reliability issues at scale. Participate in incident response and act as a technical owner where appropriate.

* **Influence:** Ability to lead through influence, technical judgment, and clear written communication, effectively bridging the gap between product needs and technical reality.
* **Agentic AI Expertise:** Proven experience building or operating agentic systems in production—moving beyond prompt engineering to architecting loops, tool-use, and error-handling strategies that ensure reliability at scale.

expanding our capabilities across continental Europe through our key hubs like
Frankfurt and Amsterdam. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product
that helps European corporate and institutional clients succeed by giving them a
holistic view of their treasury and FX operations. Built entirely on a modern,
API-first cloud infrastructure, we are the clear alternative to legacy bank
systems. We are a team of diverse experts helping our clients shape the future

WHAT WE LOOK FOR
Goldman Sachs Product Solutions Specialists are innovators, problem-solvers, and
enablers. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change, and
thrive in a fast-paced environment. For our European team, we are seeking a
specialist who combines a strong sales mindset with specialized expertise in

Our solution specialists bring modern treasury designs to life by working
closely with clients, engineers, and product managers. We look for professionals

confidently presenting cross-border FX and liquidity strategies to CFOs and

payment networks, regional clearing mechanics, and how corporate ERP and

This is a key leadership role based in Europe (with primary hubs in London,
Frankfurt, or Amsterdam) working closely with our Product, Engineering, and
Sales teams, and interacting directly with clients. We are looking for a
solutions specialist with deep subject matter expertise in corporate FX,
cross-border payment flows, and regional European transaction rails.

that address our European clients’ localized and global requirements. The role
demands an in-depth understanding of the European payments landscape—including
SEPA, SEPA Instant, T2 (TARGET2), CHAPS, and FPS—and how these networks
interface with global SWIFT messaging and ISO 20022 standards.

integration, SWIFT connectivity, and ERP/TMS configurations.

opportunities across European payment networks, including SEPA schemes, T2

Product Management, and Implementation teams to feedback regional market
trends and translate European regulatory shifts (e.g., PSD3, instant payment
mandates) into product features.
* Project Management: Seamlessly manage multiple complex integration projects
and client relationships simultaneously, ensuring smooth onboarding and quick
time-to-value.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR
* Professional Experience: Minimum of 7+ years of relevant experience in
transaction banking, corporate FX sales, payment consulting, or pre-sales
engineering.
* FX & Liquidity Expertise: Proven track record in corporate FX solutions,
cross-border payments, multi-currency pricing, and working knowledge of risk
management/hedging interfaces.
* European Rails & Standards: Comprehensive technical and functional
understanding of European clearing networks (SEPA Credit Transfer, SEPA
Instant, T2/TARGET2, CHAPS, FPS).
* Messaging & Data Standards: Deep expertise in ISO 20022 XML standards and

* ERP & TMS Knowledge: Practical understanding of how top-tier Corporate

# Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Harness Quality and Performance
London
Good Systems is the parent company behind Goodnotes, where millions of people capture and develop their ideas. Goodnotes is where we started, and it’s now the foundation for a growing family of products. By reimagining how we interact with information, we’re bringing together human creativity and the breakthrough capabilities of AI. We build products that help people turn good thinking into good work.
## Our Values
**Dream big**
* Be visionary, strategic, and open to innovation
**Build great things**
* Work in service of our users, always improving and pushing higher
**Operate like an owner**
* Take responsibility with bold decision-making and bias for action
**Win like a sports team**
* Be trusting and collaborative while empowering others
**Learn and grow fast**
* Never stop learning and iterate fast
**Share our passion**
* Share ideas and practice enthusiasm and joy
**Be user obsessed**
* Empathetic, inquisitive, practical
## About the role
You join Paddington, our AI-native product line inside Goodnotes, and work directly with Steven, our founder, and a small team shipping new products. Engineers own the full cycle: they design, build, test, ship, and operate what they ship. Coding agents write the code, and the engineer who merges it owns what lands.
You set up our quality practice. You build the agentic harness, the guides and automated checks around those agents, and you teach engineers to extend it. You are a software engineer who cares about quality. You lead the quality domain across the squads as an individual contributor and report to the Engineering Manager. We hire at Senior level and welcome Staff-level candidates.
* This role will be required to work on-site, 5 days per week in our London Paddington office
* This is a permanent role
* This role does not include visa sponsorship
## This is the role for you if you're excited to work on:
* **Product first:** Start in a product squad on day one. Ship with the team and learn how we design, build, and release, as its customer. Then build the quality practice, and keep 20 to 30 percent of your time in a squad.
* **Harness design:** Design the guides and automated checks that steer coding agents before they act and correct them after. Track which checks fire and which never fire. Squads choose what to adopt, so make it worth the choice.
* **Fast feedback:** Put fast, deterministic checks in the agent session and at pre-commit, and slow checks in CI. Write every check's message so the agent can fix the problem itself.
* **Defect discovery and risk gates:** Study past defect classes and design protection against each. Partner with squads on how we find defects before release, including AI-native approaches. Add a gate only where risk needs one, for example LLM review of risky pull requests. Report escaped defects per release and drive them down.
* **Every platform we build for:** We build for iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, web, and backend. You support all of them. Package guides and checks per platform, so new repos start protected.
* **Engineer enablement:** Teach engineers to build and tune their own checks, so the practice spreads through the squads.
## The skills you will need to be successful:
* 5 or more years in software or quality engineering, including quality frameworks, platforms, or harnesses for a team that ships through coding agents. You build agentic workflows yourself, beyond chat.
* Static analysis in depth: custom lint rules, dependency rules, and messages that guide a fix. You design pre-commit and CI flows, with fast checks early and slow checks after integration.
* You code in at least one of Swift, TypeScript, Rust, Go, or Java, and you write scripts and small systems fast.
* You make teams self-serve. Others adopt and extend your tools.
* You judge "good enough". You keep rules and feedback from overwhelming the team or the agents.
* You work with engineers, designers, and product. You set your own agenda, act before you are asked, and handle ambiguity and conflict.
**Preferred:**
* You built LLM-as-judge checks or eval suites for AI product output.
* You wrote architecture fitness functions for performance, security, or observability.
* You know web, desktop, or mobile test tools, iOS and Android in particular.
* You worked on a full-cycle team and operated what you built.
## The interview process:

# Power Integrity Engineer
Bristol, UK
## About the job
Shape the power delivery that will make Graphcore’s next-generation AI compute systems reliable.
As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will analyse power-delivery networks across silicon, package and PCB, turning complex behaviour into practical design recommendations.
You will build PDN models, investigate parasitics, and use frequency-domain and time-domain analysis to understand stability, droop, resonances and transient response. Your work will directly inform decoupling, layout, and power and ground distribution choices.
You will use electromagnetic simulation to understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance. You will also validate assumptions, identify technical risks, and connect simulation results with hardware measurements.
You will start with clearly scoped PI problems, supported by experienced engineers when wider decisions are involved. As your capability grows, you will own larger parts of the PDN.
## The team and culture
You will work alongside experienced PI engineers and colleagues across hardware disciplines, connecting analysis with real design decisions and measurements.
You will own defined technical problems and move quickly from modelling to recommendations. Decisions are grounded in evidence, physical understanding and clear communication of uncertainty.
You will contribute to design reviews, speak up when results expose risk, and take responsibility for the quality of your analysis.
## What we’re looking for
* Build, integrate and analyse PDN models for defined power rails, package structures, PCB designs or subsystems.
* Use frequency-domain impedance analysis and time-domain simulation to investigate voltage stability, droop, resonances and transient response.
* Evaluate decoupling choices and placement, considering capacitance, parasitics and the interaction between silicon, package and PCB.
* Use electromagnetic simulation to extract and understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance in power and ground structures.
* Check model setup, assumptions, convergence and physical validity, and explain the limitations of your results.
* Translate findings into practical recommendations for decoupling, layout, power and ground distribution, and other PI design choices.
* Document results, identify technical risks and contribute to design reviews and PI verification.
* Work with test engineers to define relevant measurements, interpret results and investigate differences between simulation and hardware.
* Collaborate with PI, SI

## **About H:**
When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.
H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.
## What this team owns
The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.
## What you'd be doing
* Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.
* Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.
* Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.
* Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.
* Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.
* Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.
## The first few months
By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.
## Who you'd work with
Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.
## What we think it takes
**Likely a good fit if you**
* Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.
* Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.
* Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.
* Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.
* Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.
**Stronger still if you have**
* Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.
* Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.
* Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.
* Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.
* Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.
**You do not need** a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.
## How we hire
A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.
## Practicalities
**London posting:** Hybrid in London. That means 3 office days a week and a Paris trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a Paris posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
**About the role**
The Global Internal Communications Team leads the development and successful delivery of Haleon’s company-wide internal communication strategy. Driving communications at a global level and supporting the Executive Team and senior leaders across the organisation, the team plays a key role in building colleague understanding and engagement with Haleon’s ambitions, priorities, leadership, and culture.
The Enterprise Transformation Programme is a multi-year journey focused on transforming the Haleon business. Enabled by SAP S/4HANA, it aims to build an organisation that is Wired for Excellence and deliver our Win as One Strategy. The programme will strengthen the heartbeat of our business, enabling Haleon to become more agile, efficient, and innovative while positioning the company for future growth through continuous improvement.
This roles plays a critical part in making that ambition a reality.
This is a senior role within the Global Internal Communications Team, responsible for supporting the Global Head of Internal Communications in the development and delivery of the communications and engagement strategy for the Enterprise Transformation Programme.
As a senior partner to the central programme team and programme leadership, this role will be responsible for the day-to-day delivery of internal communications and engagement activity across the programme. It will play a critical role in ensuring colleagues understand the vision, purpose, progress, and impact of the transformation while driving engagement, confidence and embedding new ways of working across the organisation.
The role will act as a senior communications partner to programme stakeholders, providing strategic counsel on narrative, messaging, communications planning, leadership engagement, and employee communications while ensuring communications activities are aligned, effectively delivered, and executed to a consistently high standard.
This role requires someone who is confident working with senior stakeholders, is an effective strategy partner and can balance strategic thinking with high-quality execution. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in a complex, global transformation environment.
It is an exciting opportunity for an experienced communications professional who enjoys both strategic thinking and hands-on delivery and thrives in a fast-paced environment.
**Role and responsibilities**
**Communications & engagement**
* Support the Global Head of Internal Communications in developing and delivering an integrated communications and engagement strategy for the Enterprise Transformation Programme, aligned with transformation milestones, business priorities and Haleon’s Win as One Strategy.
* Lead the day-to-day, coordination and delivery of communications and engagement activity across the key programme activities including programme mobilisation, design, readiness, deployment, and adoption phases.
* Act as a senior communications partner to Enterprise Transformation leadership and programme stakeholders, providing clear and constructive counsel on communications planning, narrative, audiences, messages, channels, sequencing, and engagement.
* Lead on the creation and maintenance of a compelling programme narrative and messaging framework that help colleagues understand the purpose, progress, and impact of the transformation.
* Build strong relationships and develop a detailed understanding of the programme’s strategy, roadmap, workstreams, milestones and priorities, identifying upcoming communications requirements and anticipating key moments.
* Translate complex programme, business, process, data, and technology information into clear, relevant, and accessible communications for colleagues across Haleon.
* Ensure communications plans are informed by audience needs and reflect the different experiences, information requirements, and levels of impact across functions, operating units, markets, sites, and colleague groups.
* Support programme leaders and senior stakeholders to communicate clearly and confidently about the transformation, including through leadership meetings, townhalls, employee events, function and operating-unit engagement, manager cascades, and programme updates.
* Provide strategic communications counsel and constructive challenge to programme stakeholders, helping to simplify complex information, improve communication approaches and focus activity on the needs of the audience.
* Partner with Change Management colleagues to ensure communications and engagement activity is aligned with the programme’s change, business readiness. Learning and adoption plans.
* Use outputs from stakeholder analysis, change-impact assessment, readiness activity, and employee feedback to inform communication priorities, audience planning, and messaging.
* Identify communications risks, emerging themes, and feedback, recommending actions that improve colleague understanding and engagement.
* Work in partnership with colleagues across Global Internal Communications and the wider Corporate Affairs function to ensure a co-ordinated and joined-up approach to enterprise, functional and programme communications.
* Ensure robust measurement and evaluation of programme communications effectiveness through engagement metrics, feedback, and insights, using findings to continuously improve activity and outcomes.
**Storytelling & content**
* Drive colleague engagement through impactful, audience-led storytelling that brings the Enterprise Transformation Programme to life.
* Develop communications that connect the transformation to Haleon’s Win as One Strategy, business priorities, culture, colleague experience, and long-term growth ambitions.
* Turn complex programme, process, technology and business information into engagement and accessible content. Developing high-quality internal communications content including announcements, articles, presentations, FAQs, leadership communications, briefing materials, and campaign assets.
* Identify and develop employee stories that demonstrate transformation progress, business benefits, collaboration, innovation, and new ways of working.
* Support development of multimedia content including video, infographics, and digital communications assets.
* Provide editorial guidance, review and quality assurance for communications produced by the programme, workstreams and agency partners.
* Ensure communications are tailored appropriately for different audience groups and stakeholder needs.
* Partner with External Communications colleagues to identify transformation stories that may have external relevance and support appropriate amplification, while maintaining consistency between internal and external messaging and context.
**Channels**
* Work in close partnership with other members of the Global Internal Communications Team responsible for global internal channels to ensure fully integrated and aligned approach.
* Manage the use of internal communications channels for transformation content, ensuring output is timely, accurate, and well-presented.
* Follow established channel strategies, templates and governance and support continuous improvement by sharing feedback and insight on channel effectiveness.
* Adapt communications and content for different channels and formats as required.
**Collaboration and team contribution**
* Work closely with the Global Head of Internal Communications and wider Global Internal Communications Team to ensure a consistent approach.
* Contribute to shared tools, templates, and ways of working – not only across Global Internal Communications but the wider Global Communications Team and Corporate Affairs Function.
* Support a collaborative and high-performing team environment.
**Why you?**
**Essential experience**

* Promote self-management and independence through education, advice, training, and provision of appropriate equipment.
* Contribute to service planning, policy implementation, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Support the education, supervision, and development of students and less experienced practitioners.
* Deliver and support nail surgery services, adhering to local and national clinical guidelines.

This opportunity would suit a clinically skilled and proactive podiatrist with the ability to deliver specialist care while contributing to service development and multidisciplinary working.

* Registration with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).

* Evidence of ongoing professional development and current clinical practice.

* Ability to manage a diverse caseload and make evidence-based clinical decisions.
* Excellent planning and organisational skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Confidence working independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Demonstrable IT literacy.

* Foot in Diabetes Module or equivalent qualification.
* Qualification relating to prescription-only medicines.

* Experience using SystmOne or comparable electronic patient record systems.
* Previous involvement in service improvement initiatives.

#### About the Company
**We change lives by transforming health and care.** Established in 2006, we are one of the UK's leading independent providers of community health and care services, working with health and care commissioners and communities to transform services with a focus on experience, efficiency, and improved outcomes. We deliver and transform adult and children community health services, primary care services including urgent care, sexual health, dermatology and MSK services as well as adult social care and wellbeing services. # Executive Assistant to CEO / Office Manager
**Executive Assistant and Office Manager**
Reports to: CEO
Location: London Office, 5 days a week in the office
Package: Competitive salary + annual discretionary bonus
**About the Role:**
We are searching for a fantastic Executive Assistant and Office Manager to join. The purpose of the role is to increase the effectiveness and productivity of the CEO and Executive Team by providing proactive, tech-savvy administrative and project support. The role combines traditional EA responsibilities with office management and a forward-thinking approach to improving business processes through technology, AI tools, and smart working practices.
**About Healthxchange:**
Founded in 2000, Healthxchange is the leading supplier of medical aesthetic products and services to professionals across the UK & Ireland. Healthxchange proudly partner with award-winning brands including Obagi Medical, Medik8, Jan Marini, and Jane Iredale to strategically commercialise their products in market. We currently supply over 9,000 clinics with a full range of products (Skincare, Injectables, Energy-based devices) and services (software & education) to support their 360 business needs. The company offers a dynamic environment for innovation and growth in the medical aesthetic space.
**Responsibilities:**
***CEO & Executive Team Support***
* Provide day-to-day administrative and secretarial support to the CEO as the primary point of contact, and as a secondary priority to the wider Executive Team
* Manage and coordinate the CEO's diary, scheduling meetings, calls, and travel with efficiency and sound judgement
* Assist the Executive Team with diary management, meeting scheduling, and general coordination
* Prepare briefing materials, agendas, and correspondence on behalf of the CEO
* Act as a gatekeeper for the CEO's time, prioritising requests and managing competing demands
* Support the CEO on confidential projects requiring discretion, including sensitive commercial, regulatory, or people matters, and provide lighter company secretarial support such as coordinating with external company secretaries and maintaining statutory registers
***Executive Meeting Governance:***
* Own the rhythm of recurring leadership meetings (weekly Exec stand-ups, monthly leadership meetings, quarterly offsites), including managing agendas, pre-reads, follow-ups, and action tracking
***Technology & Process Improvement***
* Identify and implement smarter ways of working, including using AI tools to improve meeting scheduling, travel booking, and other administrative workflows
* Troubleshoot lower-grade IT issues in meeting rooms and shared office spaces (e.g. video conferencing setup, display connectivity, audio problems)
* Research and recommend new tools or platforms that improve efficiency across the business
* Lead or support ad-hoc projects as delegated by the CEO, including process improvement and operational initiatives
***Travel & Events***
* Manage travel requests for the CEO and Executive Team, and oversee travel arrangements across the wider business, advising on cost-effective options
* Support on-the-road sales staff with ad-hoc logistical issues
* Assist with the planning, coordination, and delivery of key company events
**Information & Documents**
* Maintain a central register of all key policies and corporate documents
**Facilities & Office Management**
* Act as the London office manager, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the Victoria office, including supplies, cleaning, maintenance, and landlord liaison
* Own the visitor experience at the London office, including room bookings, catering, greeting clients and partners, and ensuring the right technology is set up for meetings
* Support Group-wide facilities management by centralising office administration and acting as the point of contact for facilities queries
***People Team Support***
* Provide cover for the People Team Coordinator during periods of annual leave, handling onboarding and offboarding processes and preparing employment offer documentation
* Support the smooth arrival of new starters in the London office, ensuring desks are ready, IT is set up, and introductions are scheduled
**Requirements:**
* Experience working as an EA, PA, or in a similar support role, ideally within a fast-paced or tech-enabled environment
* Genuinely comfortable with technology - curious about new tools, confident troubleshooting everyday IT issues, and enthusiastic about using AI and automation to improve ways of working
* Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple live tasks with accuracy and initiative
* Excellent verbal, written, and numerical communication skills
* Sound judgement, discretion, and the ability to maintain absolute confidentiality
* Proactive and resourceful - someone who anticipates needs, takes ownership of projects, and delivers without close supervision
* Comfortable managing upwards and across a senior leadership team, including chasing Exec members for deliverables
* A commitment to providing excellent service
***IT Skills***
* Microsoft 365 at an intermediate to advanced level (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
* Confident using AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline administrative processes, and identify smarter ways of working, with a willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new tools.
* Able to diagnose and resolve basic AV and IT issues in meeting rooms
**Benefits**
Company pension, annual performance bonus, 23 days holiday plus bank holidays (and increasing with service), staff discount, staff social events, access to Health Assured EA, Birthday Off Perk.

# Head of Facilities and Safety
**Head of Facilities and Safety**
Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer
Location: London-based (multi-site oversight, with regular travel between all locations)
Compensation: Competitive salary + annual bonus + car allowance
**About the Role:**
The Head of Facilities and Safety keeps every Healthxchange site safe, compliant and fit for purpose, so our teams can dispatch customer orders on time and in full (OTIF).You'll own health and safety, fire safety, premises maintenance and site security across our pharmacies in London, Manchester and Reading, as well as our regional distribution centre (RDC).
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll work closely with the Superintendent Pharmacist and Responsible Person to ensure our premises meet MHRA Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and GPhC standards. You'll also partner with Operations, Pharmacy, HR and Finance.
**About Healthxchange:**
Founded in 2000, Healthxchange is the leading supplier of medical aesthetic products and services to professionals across the UK & Ireland. Healthxchange proudly partner with award-winning brands including Obagi Medical, Medik8 and Jane Iredale to strategically commercialise their products in market. We currently supply over 9,000 clinics with a full range of products (Skincare, Injectables, Energy-based devices) and services (software & education) to support their 360 business needs. The company offers a dynamic environment for innovation and growth in the medical aesthetic space.
**Responsibilities**:
***Health and safety***
* Own the health and safety policy and management system across all sites, in line with the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974 and related regulations
* Carry out and keep up to date risk assessments, including COSHH, manual handling, display screen equipment (DSE), and new and expectant mothers
* Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses, find root causes and track corrective actions to completion
* Manage RIDDOR reporting and keep the accident log accurate
* Run regular site safety audits and inspections, and report findings to the COO
* Make sure enough trained first aiders and fire marshals are in place at every site and on every shift
***Fire safety and security***
* Ensure each site has a current fire risk assessment and that its actions are completed
* Manage fire alarm, emergency lighting and extinguisher testing and servicing, and run regular evacuation drills
* Oversee site security, including access control, CCTV, intruder alarms, key holding and secure storage for controlled drugs, working with the Superintendent Pharmacist
* Own business continuity and emergency plans for each site, including power or IT failure, flooding and fridge or cold room failure
***Facilities and maintenance***
* Manage planned and reactive maintenance for buildings, plant and equipment, including HVAC, electrics, water, lifts and loading bays
* Manage statutory compliance testing, such as fixed wire (EICR), PAT, gas safety, Legionella and asbestos management
* Make sure material handling equipment (MHE) and pallet racking are inspected and safe, including LOLER, PUWER and SEMA racking inspections
* Procure and manage facilities contractors and suppliers, such as cleaning, waste, pest control, security and maintenance, including contracts, performance and permits to work
* Act as the main contact for landlords, managing agents and surveyors, including lease obligations, dilapidations and service charges
***GDP and regulatory premises compliance***
* Ensure premises and equipment support MHRA GDP and GPhC requirements, working with the Responsible Person and Superintendent Pharmacist
* Manage temperature control and monitoring systems, including temperature mapping, calibration, alarms and out-of-hours response
* Keep pest control, cleaning and waste management (including pharmaceutical and hazardous waste) compliant and well documented
* Support MHRA, GPhC, local authority and insurer inspections, and own any premises-related actions
***Projects and site changes***
* Lead facilities workstreams for new sites, relocations, fit-outs and expansions, from basis of design through to handover
* Manage external consultants and contractors
* Ensure new or changed spaces are safe, compliant and ready to operate before go-live
***Budget and reporting***
* Own the facilities and health and safety budget, including maintenance, contracts and capital spend
* Look for cost savings, for example in energy, waste and contractor spend, without reducing safety or compliance
* Report monthly on safety, compliance and facilities performance to the COO and senior leadership team
***People and culture***
* Build a positive safety culture where everyone reports hazards and near misses
* Plan and deliver health and safety training, including inductions, manual handling, fire safety and refreshers
* Support site managers to understand and meet their safety and facilities responsibilities
* Line manage any facilities team members and oversee contractors
**Requirements:**
**Essential**
* NEBOSH National General Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety, or equivalent
* At least 5 years' experience in facilities management and/or health and safety, including at least 2 years in a management role
* Experience managing several sites, ideally in warehousing, logistics, retail pharmacy or another regulated environment
* Strong working knowledge of UK health and safety, fire safety and statutory compliance requirements
* Proven experience managing contractors, budgets and maintenance programmes
* Excellent organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities across sites
* Clear, confident communicator who can influence people at all levels
**Desirable**
* NEBOSH Diploma, or Chartered or Graduate membership of IOSH (CMIOSH or GradIOSH)
* IWFM qualification or membership
* Experience of MHRA GDP, temperature-controlled storage or pharmaceutical distribution
* Experience of fit-out or new-site projects, including CDM 2015
* Fire risk assessment qualification
* Experience with CAFM or compliance management systems
**Benefits:**
Company pension, annual performance bonus, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (and increasing with service), staff discount, staff social events, access to Health Assured EAP, birthday off perk.

All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.*

# Procurement Project Manager – UK
* Full-time

## Who we are
Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. ## The role
As Procurement Project Manager at Helsing, you will take ownership of procurement activities across development and customer projects, working within established programme structures while bringing increasing independence to how you manage suppliers, timelines, and cost. You will be involved early in project phases, giving you the opportunity to contribute to sourcing decisions before they become fixed constraints. Your work connects engineering, supply chain, production, and external partners, and your ability to coordinate across those boundaries will determine whether projects are set up to deliver. From prototyping through to production ramp-up, you will ensure that the right suppliers are selected, that costs stay on track, and that quality is maintained throughout. At this level, you will be building the experience and judgement needed to manage increasingly complex scopes, supported by senior colleagues while taking genuine responsibility for defined workstreams.
## The day-to-day
* Support and lead procurement activities across development and customer projects, ensuring cost, quality, and schedule targets are met across assigned workstreams
* Engage early in project planning phases to contribute to sourcing strategies, flag potential supply risks, and align procurement timelines with engineering and programme milestones
* Research, evaluate, and recommend suppliers for technical components and systems, applying clear assessment criteria and escalating trade-offs for senior review where appropriate
* Serve as a reliable interface between engineering, procurement, suppliers, and production teams, ensuring technical requirements are clearly communicated and that issues are surfaced promptly
* Support prototyping, industrialisation, and serial production ramp-up phases, adapting procurement approaches as projects move through different stages of development
* Track supplier performance against agreed commitments and flag deviations in cost, quality, or delivery early enough for corrective action to be taken
* Contribute to building and maintaining a qualified supplier base that meets Helsing's technical and compliance requirements
## You should apply if you
* Have managed procurement activities within technically complex or project-driven environments, taking responsibility for defined workstreams from requirements through to delivery
* Can read and interpret technical documentation well enough to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and assess supplier capabilities without constant support
* Have coordinated across cross-functional teams, keeping engineering, production, and supplier stakeholders aligned on priorities and timelines
* Have supported or led supplier negotiations and relationship management for technical components, with an understanding of what good contract terms look like
* Bring a structured and methodical approach to managing competing priorities, with the ability to escalate clearly when trade-offs arise
* Communicate clearly (in both written and spoken English), adjusting your level of detail to suit technical and non-technical audiences
**Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* *under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.**
## Nice to Have
* Exposure to defence, aerospace, or other regulated industries where compliance, traceability, and quality requirements shape procurement practice
* Familiarity with industrialisation or production ramp-up phases, with an understanding of how sourcing needs shift from development to volume supply
* Experience working with ERP or procurement management systems in a project-led organisation
## Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about
## What we offer
* **Competitive salary** and **VSOP options**
* **Relocation support**: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
* **Learning**: €500/£450 yearly allowance
* **Health & wellness**: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
* **Social**: regularly company events and monthly social allowances
* **Enhanced parental leave**: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
* **Family support:** 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

# Support Practitioner Mental Health
* Job Reference: 00005204-1
* Date Posted: 2 October 2026
* Recruiter: You Matter
* Location: Liverpool
* Salary: £30,000
* Role: Frontline jobs
* Job type: Permanent
* Work hours: Full Time
## Job Description
**Location:** Stepping Stones Mental Health Service
**Salary:** £30,000 per annum
**Hours:** 37.5 per annum
**Job Type:** Permanent/Fixed Term
**Shortlisting:** 19th October
**Interview:** 23rd October: Assessment Day
### **Why this role would be great for you**
As a Support Practitioner at You Matter you will naturally be an empathetic and caring person wanting to provide unconditional support for those experiencing mental health issues. Your role as a Support Practitioner will be to create a safe environment that empowers residents to make positive changes in their lives. There are times in all our lives when we experience periods of crisis. Some of us need extra support to help us through these times, and hospital admission is not always the best option. Stepping Stones is a partnership with Mersey Care that provides eight beds of accommodation and support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for people in mental health crises.
### **What your week may look like**
* Welcoming new residents in line with the service’s policies and procedures, carry out risk assessments and support people to continue in their journey towards independence
* Ensuring the basic needs of residents are met including good quality accommodation and facilities, healthy food, advice and guidance
* Advocate for social inclusion of the people you support ensuring they are able to access health and financial support
* Developing relationships with other support services such as social services, mental health teams, substance use services other healthcare providers
* Developing and reviewing written safety plans and support plans with your residents that reflect their own needs, changes and hopes for the future
* Work alongside the people in our services to address their physical and mental health issues, including liaison with primary and secondary health teams
* Carrying out the immediate support needs of residents as appropriate, providing crisis intervention where necessary and working with services
* Ensuring all health and safety and maintenance issues are raised in a timely manner
* Participating in team meetings, supervisions and reflective practice encouraging open, honest and transparent feedback where continuous improvement is encouraged.
* Being flexible and responsive to the changing needs of the service, ensuring our SHREK values runs through all of the work that you do
* Promoting a supportive and inclusive culture within the service, valuing people and their diversity.
### What We Can Offer You
What can we offer Working with You Matter comes will a whole host of benefits. We hope that people will find personal fulfilment and purpose by working with alongside people in our services. Our teams are compassionate and supportive, fostering a strong sense of community. With opportunities for professional growth, You Matter offers training to support your role and personal development. For a full list of benefits see here: Careers Page | You Matter.
### **The skills we are looking for:**
**EXPERIENCE**
* Experience of supporting individuals with complex needs, including mental health, substance misuse and housing instability
* Experience of adult and/or child safeguarding
* Experience of multi-agency and partnership working (e.g. Mental Health, Social Care)
* Experience of risk assessment and safety planning
* Experience of resettlement or move-on into safe, independent accommodation
* Experience managing incidents, maintenance or health and safety concerns
* Strong administrative and case-recording skills
**KNOWLEDGE**
* Understanding of trauma-informed and person centred practice
* Knowledge of safeguarding
* Understanding of complex needs including mental health, substance misuse and offending
**EMPATHY and RESPECT**
* Commitment to You Matter ethos, philosophy and SHREK values: Strength, Humility, Respect, Empathy and Kindness
* Compassionate, professional and non-judgemental approach
* Confident, energetic and self-motivated
**COMMITMENT**
* Strong commitment to improving outcomes for people experiencing difficult times in their lives and empowering them towards independence
* Commitment to reflective practice and continuous professional development
**ORGANISATION**
* Creative and solution-focused approach to complex situations
* Excellent organisational and time-management skills
* Strong negotiation and mediation skills
* Respected by peers and able to motivate others
**COMMUNICATION AND COMPUTER LITERACY**
* Demonstrable verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent communication, engagement and interpersonal skills
* Ability to build rapport with colleagues and people we work alongside
* Confident using Microsoft Word, Outlook and Windows-based systems
* Experience of case management or recording systems
### **What is a nice to have**
* Qualification in Health and Social Care, Mental Health or other relevant subject
* Experience working in a customer facing role and a desire to support people to make a positive impact/change in their lives
* Experience of working within a psychologically informed working environment
* Knowledge of housing management and IT databases
* Awareness of benefits and how they work including Universal Credit and other welfare systems
Even if you don’t feel that you have all the relevant skills and “nice to haves” we would still like to hear from you and invite you to fill out our application form.
You Matter is an equal opportunities employer, values diversity and is strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and all applicants for employment. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender, ethnicity, religion and sexual orientation.

# Engineering Manager - Customer and Claims
## Lead product-minded engineering teams to make buying, managing policies and claiming simpler for customers, while building reliable systems and helping engineers thrive.
**ABOUT HOMEPROTECT** **Cover for Almost every Home**
We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.
If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.
**What It's Like to Work Here**
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.
We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.
We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.
**ROLE PURPOSE**
Customer Experience and Operations owns the customer's whole relationship with Homeprotect: everything a customer touches, and everything our people use to help them. From the customer's point of view, it is one story:
* **Finding us and buying:** our connections to price comparison websites, the quote and buy journey, and the customer portal.
* **Living with their policy:** self-service policy changes, renewals, documents and the messages we send them.
* **Getting help when they need it:** telephony, webchat, case management, and the workspace our agents use every day.
* **Making a claim:** reporting it online, assessment, settlement and payments, our connections to the supplier network, and the tools our claims handlers rely on.
* **Keeping it fair and consistent:** fraud management, complaints, a single view of the customer, and the design system that makes every journey look and feel like Homeprotect.
The engineering challenge is to make all of this feel like one experience, even though it runs on many different systems.
We're looking for a product-minded Engineering Manager to lead this area. You'll build and grow a high-performing engineering team across multiple squads, partner with the area's Product Managers, and make sure the team ships often, safely and with high standards of craft.
Rather than delivering projects from a shared backlog, you'll lead long-lived product engineering squads responsible for the reliability, evolution and technical health of this area. You'll create the environment where engineers can do their best work while balancing short-term delivery with long-term sustainability.
Success in this role means customers get a simple, consistent experience whether they are buying, managing their policy or making a claim, our people have reliable tools that help them, and the systems behind it all are owned, understood and easy to change.
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Team Leadership & People Development**
* Build, lead and grow a healthy, high-performing engineering team across several squads, through effective hiring, coaching, mentoring and performance management.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Develop engineers through regular feedback, career development and technical coaching, and grow the next generation of technical leads.
* Foster psychological safety while maintaining high standards of engineering excellence.
* Build an engineering culture aligned with Homeprotect's Engineering Excellence Framework, encouraging technical quality, product thinking, delivery excellence and continuous improvement.
* Create clarity around goals, expectations and success measures, so each squad knows what it owns and why it matters.
**Engineering Ownership**
* Own the engineering strategy, delivery and operational health of Customer Experience and Operations, from customer-facing journeys to the systems our people use behind the scenes.
* Define and evolve the technical roadmap, balancing business priorities with long-term sustainability and scalability.
* Lead the shift from configured vendor platforms to owned, engineered products: clear integration services, testable logic, and good data quality.
* Make pragmatic build, buy or integrate decisions with the Product Managers, based on cost, speed, control and long-term flexibility.
* Keep the customer-facing experience fast, accessible and consistent, and grow the design system as a shared product other teams build on.
* Support controlled experiments on customer journeys, with the tracking and data the Product Managers need to trust the results.
* Deliver predictably and often, while maintaining high standards of quality, resilience and operational excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, reliability, change failure rate and operational excellence.
* Lead incident response and post-incident learning for systems owned by the team. Many of them are used live by agents and claims handlers, so reliability has a direct impact on customers.
* Champion AI-assisted development across the team, and work with the AI team so that AI capabilities in claims and customer service are well integrated, reliable and built on clean data.
**Product & Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with the Product Managers to define priorities, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, keeping the customer's journey joined up across the whole area.
* Own the domain backlogs jointly with the Product Managers: prioritisation and grooming are a shared activity, not something the team receives as tickets from Product.
* Work closely with Claims and Customer Service leaders to understand how their teams work and where our systems slow them down.
* Work closely with Marketing and Commercial teams on acquisition and conversion.
* Work with Underwriting & Pricing, Policy Administration and Finance teams, whose core platforms the customer journeys are built on.
* Manage the technical side of key vendor and partner relationships, so their platforms fit our architecture rather than shape it.
* Build trusted relationships across Technology and the wider business, helping stakeholders understand engineering trade-offs and shaping pragmatic solutions.
* Contribute to organisation-wide engineering standards, platform improvements and architectural direction beyond your own area.
**Engineering Excellence & Continuous Improvement**
* Create an environment where engineers consistently deliver high-quality software, continuously improve their craft and take ownership of business outcomes.
* Encourage experimentation, learning and pragmatic decision-making while maintaining the operational discipline expected of systems customers and colleagues rely on every day.
* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce technical debt and remove fragile, hard-to-change configuration.
* Help shape Homeprotect's engineering standards, tooling, observability and platform capabilities as the organisation continues its product engineering transformation.
* Promote modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, observability and secure software development.
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**
**Essential**
* A solid track record leading engineering teams with accountability for people, delivery, technical health and operational excellence, ideally across more than one squad.
* Strong technical background with the ability to engage deeply on architecture and software design, across both customer-facing applications and backend services.
* Experience integrating with and taking ownership of third-party platforms (for example customer relationship, workflow, telephony or claims platforms), and making sound build, buy or integrate decisions.
* Hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing and cloud-native development.
* Experience operating production systems requiring high availability, performance and resilience.
* Experience leading long-lived product engineering teams with ownership of a business capability rather than delivering project-based work.
* Experience partnering closely with Product Managers to balance customer value, engineering investment and delivery priorities.
* Hands-on with AI-assisted engineering tools, and able to help a team adopt them well.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with non-engineering stakeholders such as Operations, Claims, Marketing or Commercial teams.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across both business and technology.
**Desirable**
* Experience within General Insurance or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience building digital customer journeys at scale, including experimentation and conversion work.
* Experience with Salesforce or a similar customer relationship platform, or with a claims administration platform.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into operational or customer service systems.
* Experience with design systems and accessibility standards.
* Experience leading organisations through the transition from project-based delivery to domain-oriented product teams.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Azure and cloud-native engineering practices.
**BENEFITS**
We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.
**Learning and Growth:** We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on-the-job experience and cross-functional projects. We support role-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.
**Health and Wellbeing:** Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.
**Financial Security and Reward:** We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme upto 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance - with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.
**Time Off:** 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.
**Genuine Flexible Working** We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them - with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.
**Purpose and Community:** We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.
**UNIQUE AS STANDARD**
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference - everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.
We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.
*Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.*
***Regulatory Responsibilities***
*As an FCA regulated insurer, doing the right thing isn't a compliance requirement - it's simply how we work. All colleagues are expected to uphold the FCA Individual Conduct Rules (1–6) and act with integrity, due skill and care, openness with regulators and a genuine commitment to delivering good outcomes for our customers.*
*You'll work within approved processes and authority limits, keep accurate and auditable records, protect data under UK GDPR and our information security policies, escalate risks and exceptions promptly, report incidents, breaches and any financial crime or sanctions concerns (including via whistleblowing), support vulnerable customers with reasonable adjustments, and complete all mandatory training to maintain competence.*
*If the role falls within SM&CR, a supplementary document outlining the key regulatory responsibilities will be provided.*

## About the Role
HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.
Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.
You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.
This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You’ll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.
You’ll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer’s wider technology estate.
A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.
Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.
From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.
The role does not end at first deployment. You’ll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You’ll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.

### Own Customer Outcomes
• Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.
• Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.
• Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.
• Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.
• Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.
### Lead Discovery and Solution Design
• Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.
• Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.
• Understand the customer’s existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.
• Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.
• Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.
• Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.
### Build and Ship Production Solutions
• Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.
• Develop AI powered applications, copilots, agents, automations, integrations and workflow solutions.
• Build solutions that make effective use of modern enterprise data platforms and ensure AI applications are supported by reliable, governed and accessible data.
• Integrate solutions with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow and customer owned systems, APIs and data platforms.
• Apply modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability and secure development.
• Work iteratively. Deliver value quickly, learn from real world usage and progressively harden solutions for enterprise production.
### Engineer AI and Agentic Solutions
• Design and implement robust agentic workflows, human in the loop processes and, where appropriate, multi agent architectures.
• Apply modern techniques across retrieval, grounding, orchestration, tool integration, context engineering and evaluation.
• Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails to test AI behaviour, reliability and quality before and after deployment.
