### Create Reusable HSO Capability
• Reuse existing HSO assets, accelerators and delivery patterns wherever they improve speed and quality.
• Turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, engineering patterns and playbooks.
• Contribute actively to HSO’s AI, Data, Frontier and Horizon engineering communities.
• Share practical knowledge across regions, practices and delivery teams.
• Support and mentor other engineers as the Forward Deployed Engineering capability grows.
## What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for experienced engineers who combine strong technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate confidently with customers.
You’ll ideally bring:

• Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data platforms and modern distributed application architectures.
• Experience with modern engineering and DevOps practices including CI/CD, automated testing, source control and infrastructure as code.

## Why Join HSO?
AI is changing how organisations operate, but most businesses do not need more demonstrations or isolated pilots. They need people who can identify where AI will genuinely create value, ensure the underlying data foundations are fit for purpose and then build something that works in production.
That is what this role is designed to do.
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at HSO, you’ll work directly with strategic customers at the point where emerging AI, data and cloud capabilities meet real business problems.
You’ll have the opportunity to:

## About the Role
AI is creating significant opportunities for organisations, but identifying where it can genuinely transform a business is often harder than building the technology itself.
That is where the Deployment Strategist comes in.
Deployment Strategists combine elements of management consulting, product management, business analysis and technology strategy. Their primary responsibility is to understand a customer’s business deeply enough to identify where the greatest value can be created, where the most important problems exist, and where AI and agentic technologies can realistically help solve them.
You’ll work closely with senior customer stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operating models, processes and performance challenges before translating them into focused opportunities that can be delivered and measured.

This technical understanding will allow you to identify realistic opportunities, challenge assumptions, work credibly with technical teams and help customers make informed choices about where Microsoft technologies can create the greatest value.
Deployment Strategists work side by side with Forward Deployed Engineers. The Deployment Strategist owns the why and the what, identifying the opportunity, defining the desired outcome and establishing how success will be measured. The FDE owns the how, designing and building the production solution.
Together, you will take opportunities from discovery through to production and demonstrate the value they create.
A critical part of the role is proving impact. You’ll establish clear baselines and success measures at the outset, remain closely connected to customer stakeholders throughout delivery, and demonstrate how the solution is affecting KPIs, operational performance or other measurable business outcomes.
The role does not end at first deployment. Deployment Strategists drive an ongoing cycle of identify, build, prove and expand, using each successful outcome to uncover the next opportunity and deepen the value HSO delivers to the customer.

This is a hands-on build role in a fast-moving prototype and NPI environment, scaling towards production. The role reports to the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management.
# What You'll Do
**Strategy and leadership**
* Define the WILP strategy and roadmap, aligned with company strategy and the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management.
* Build a lean operating model, governance, KPIs and cadence for warehouse, inventory, logistics and planning that works in a fast-changing NPI environment and scales as volumes grow.

* Foster a high‐performance, collaborative, curious and continuous‐improvement culture.
* Decisive and data driven, able to make priority calls under pressure.
* Confident communicator with customers and executives, keeps promises and raises risks early.

* Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and regulatory standards across all WILP operations.
* Act as deputy for the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management when required.
**Planning and order fulfilment**
* Build a pragmatic planning and scheduling process suited to NPI and prototype builds, evolving towards make to order, assemble to order and configure to order flows as volumes ramp.
* Run daily and weekly tier meetings to manage exceptions, shortages, and expedites, ensuring clear root‐cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Lead the available to promise process, including project slotting and allocations during shortages.
* Ensure export compliance, documentation accuracy and clean handover to carriers and customs partners.

* Oversee and execute inventory counts, reconciliation, and audits.
* Monitor and manage stock levels to meet customer demands and avoid overstock or shortages.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve inventory processes and accuracy.
* Maintain a clean, organised, and safe warehouse environment.
**Logistics & Supplier / Customer focus**
* Design a logistics model that supports today’s site-to-site and prototype flows and can scale to central and regional DCs and cross docks.
* Select and manage 3PLs, carriers and freight forwarders with clear SLAs and regular performance reviews.
* Implement transport management and consolidation rules that protect on-time delivery and cost.
* Strong understanding of Incoterms and global trade compliance.
* Good understanding of logistics processes across the Americas, UK, and Europe.
* Ensure warehouse processes, inventory accuracy and cycle counting reach Group standards, using WMS capability as it is introduced.
* Build fulfilment playbooks for customer deployments, including kitting, pre assembly and sequenced deliveries to site.
* Create a proactive milestone tracking and communication model that gives customers crystal clear ETAs and risks.
* Agree service levels by customer segment, including on-time in-full targets, lead time windows and communication rules, as customer volumes build.

+ Proven success serving project based or engineer to order customers.
+ Proven leadership of multi‐site or multi‐region operations and external logistics partners

+ Strong analytical, numerical, and planning capabilities.
**Behavioural Skills**

This is a hands-on role. You’ll build tooling yourself, and you’ll help set how your team adopts it.
**Your role in the Team’s Success:**
This role suits engineers with a strong grounding in software engineering practice: test-driven development, pair programming, and real ownership of systems from design through to production support, with real depth in Java or a comparable backend service ecosystem. The fundamentals matter most: engineers who can write their own tests, review their own designs, and catch their own defects, and who use AI to extend that practice further and faster. Growing into the person the whole group comes to for technical judgement is part of the role.
**Our ambition: engineering that runs itself:**
The long-term goal is a pipeline where AI agents handle the bulk of coding support, testing, and triage end-to-end, largely unattended, with engineers stepping in for genuine judgement calls and exceptions. We’re early on that path today, and we want someone in this role who treats the destination as real and pushes their team toward it deliberately.
**What you’ll do:**
* Build and maintain internal tooling that embeds AI into day-to-day engineering work: coding assistants, AI-assisted test generation, deployments, and defect triage.
* Contribute to observability in the AI-assisted pipeline, so every stage shows what the tooling is doing, catching, and missing.
* Identify manual steps in coding, testing, and release that can run largely unattended, and help build the automation to get there.
* Split work into small, releasable pieces that ship continuously.
* Work closely with a product person on your product domain, so what you build is grounded in real delivery.
* Treat improving ways of working and driving AI adoption as a fundamental, ongoing part of delivering value.
* Work with the test and PM function to bring AI into the testing pipeline: exploratory test generation, defect clustering, flaky-test detection, and smarter prioritisation of what to test.
* Evaluate and help roll out LLM-based developer tools, for example Claude Code and similar, integrating them safely with our Jira, Confluence, and GitLab environments.
* Follow and help refine standards for responsible AI use in the SDLC: data handling, prompt hygiene, and guardrails around production and customer data.
* Mentor less experienced engineers on effective use of AI tooling.
* Work with security and compliance to make sure AI tooling meets IG’s regulatory and data-handling requirements.
* Track the metrics that show whether AI tooling is helping: cycle time, defect escape rate, test coverage, delivery turnaround. Iterate based on what the data shows.
**What you’ll need for this role:**
* Extensive background as a Software Engineer, with demonstrated technical judgement on production systems.
* Solid, hands-on expertise in Java or a comparable backend service ecosystem.
* Strong fluency in test-driven development and pair programming as working disciplines.
* Real ownership experience: you’ve designed features or systems, built them, deployed them, and supported them in production.
* A genuine appetite for aggressive automation. You get energised by removing manual steps entirely.
* Some experience evaluating or using LLM-based developer tools in a real engineering environment.
**Preferred**
* Experience with MCP, agentic tooling, or Spec Driven Development.
* Familiarity with the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence) and its APIs.
* Prior experience in financial services, trading platforms, or another regulated, high-reliability environment.

## Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Silicon Engineering Platform
**Job no:** 502909 **Work type:** Experienced Professional **Location:** Kings Langley UK, Bristol UK **Categories:** Graphics ### **The role**
We are building a silicon engineering platform that turns a commit of GPU/AI hardware code into an orchestrated workflow automation that proves it is ready for customer release, including an ML/AI layer that learns to predict how to get there in the fewest workloads possible. This is a large transformation project with executive sponsorship, starting from a clean-sheet design.
Designing semiconductor IP involves many tool flows: static analysers, theorem provers, simulation farms running tens of thousands of randomised tests every night, physical design tools that estimate future speed and power needs of silicon. These tools run on a variety of compute platforms - grid, emulator, FPGA, silicon boards.
At many companies, including ours, such a stack is held together by decades of scripts, tribal knowledge and manual steps. To replace it, we are building a modern orchestration platform to that coordinates long-running, resource-intensive compute jobs. Our goal is to break monolithic, hard-to-debug pipelines into small, composable, independently testable building blocks — with clear observability and intelligent failure handling.
You do not need to know anything about semiconductor hardware; the tools are black boxes with defined inputs, outputs and exit codes, and we have engineers available to explain the domain. What we need is good software engineering, because underneath the domain is a big distributed-systems problem - with orchestration at scale, scheduling around scarce resources, content-addressed caching, data engineering, and correctness problems
You will own the application-layer design: the orchestration logic, task/flow abstractions, data models, and the interfaces those components expose. You'll work closely with a principal platform/infrastructure engineer who owns deployment, security, and networking concerns — freeing you to focus on writing clean, well-tested, maintainable orchestration code.
Your engineering principles and the quality of your craft matter more to us than prior exposure to our domain and stack, and we'll cover specifics in interview.
You will:
* Design and implement orchestration logic using a modern workflow engine (e.g. flows, subflows, and tasks in a Prefect-like system), decomposing monolithic pipelines into small, reusable, independently testable units.
* Apply solid software design principles (SOLID, separation of concerns, composition over inheritance) to keep orchestration code maintainable as complexity grows.
* Define clear, strongly-typed data contracts between pipeline stages (e.g. using Pydantic or similar), favoring lightweight references/pointers over passing large payloads through the orchestration layer.
* Design retry, checkpoint, and resume logic so long-running jobs can recover from failure without re-doing completed work.
* Implement human-in-the-loop patterns: pausing pipelines for review/approval, and cleanly resuming or rerouting execution based on human input.
* Write thorough automated tests (unit, integration) for orchestration logic, including failure-path and edge-case coverage — treat testability as a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought.
* Build observability into the application layer: structured logging, metrics extraction, and clear status/error reporting surfaced to end users.
* Collaborate with the platform/infrastructure lead to consume infrastructure cleanly (secrets, environment config, execution targets) via well-defined interfaces, without hardcoding infra assumptions into application code.
* Participate in code review, championing readability, composability, and pragmatic simplicity over premature abstraction.
* Contribute to technical documentation and onboarding materials as the codebase and patterns mature.
### **About you**
Committed to making your customers, stakeholders and colleagues successful, you’re an excellent communicator, listener and collaborator who builds trusted partnerships by delivering what you say, when you say. You’re curious, solutions orientated and a world-class problem solver who constantly seeks opportunities to innovate and achieve the best possible outcome to the highest imaginable standard.
You will have:
* Experience of professional software development, with a strong command of Python (preferred) or an equivalent modern, strongly-typed-capable language.
* Demonstrated understanding of SOLID principles, OOP design, and composition-based architecture — able to explain trade-offs, not just recite acronyms.
* Proven ability to write testable code: dependency injection, mocking/stubbing external systems, clear separation between I/O and business logic.
* Experience building composable software: small, well-scoped modules/functions/classes that combine predictably, rather than large monolithic scripts.
* Comfortable with asynchronous programming (e.g. Python ) for coordinating external process execution and I/O-bound work.
* Experience designing data models/schemas (e.g. Pydantic, dataclasses, or equivalent) and using type checking to prevent integration errors.
* Solid understanding of error handling and failure-mode design: retries, idempotency, graceful degradation.
* Familiarity with version control workflows (Git), CI pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (pytest or equivalent).
* Comfortable working in Linux environments and calling out to external CLI tools/subprocesses safely.
You might also have experience of the following:
* Direct experience with a workflow orchestration framework (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar).
* Experience with containerization (Docker, or HPC-oriented tools like Apptainer/Singularity).
* Exposure to systems that coordinate with external schedulers/queues (HPC job schedulers, batch systems, message queues).
* Experience building internal developer tooling or platform-as-product style systems (i.e., building things other engineers build on top of).
* Basic familiarity with cloud services (Azure preferred) and infrastructure concepts (you won't own these, but conversational fluency helps collaboration).
### **Who we are**
Imagination is a UK-based company that creates silicon and software IP designed to give its customers an edge in competitive global technology markets. Its GPU and AI technologies enable outstanding power, performance, and area (PPA), fast time-to-market, and lower total cost of ownership. Products based on Imagination IP are used by billions of people across the globe in their smartphones, cars, homes, and workplaces.
We need your skills to help us continue to deliver technology that will impress the industry and our customers alike, ensuring that people everywhere can enjoy smarter and faster tech than ever before.
### **So come join us if you're wanting that something more**
Bring your talent, curiosity and expertise and we’ll help you do the rest. You’ll be part of one of the world’s most exciting companies who are one of the leaders in semiconductor IP solutions.
As a part of our team, you can help us transform, innovate, and inspire the lives of millions through our technology.

# Senior Web Designer, Growth
London, England
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
## **About this role**
Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.
You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.
You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.
## **What you’ll be doing**
* **Experimentation:** Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.
* **Collaboration:** Working with Growth, Self-serve, Brand, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to turn opportunities into clear, buildable experiences.
* **Data and insight:** Using user insights and funnel data to identify opportunities, define hypotheses, and measure impact.
* **Product design:** Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.
* **Prototyping and systems:** Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.
* **Roadmap ownership:** Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.
## **Must have experience**
* **Experience:** 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.
* **Growth mindset:** A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.
* **Experimentation:** Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.
* **Craft and taste:** Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.
* **Systems and brand:** Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.
* **AI fluency:** Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.
* **Ownership:** Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.
## **Who this role is not for**
This role is not for you if:
* You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.
* You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.
* You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.
* You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.
* You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.
* You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.
## **What success looks like**
You’ll know you’re successful if:
* More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.
* You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.
* Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.
* You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.
* You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.
* You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.
## **Interview process**
We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.
You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.
## **Ready to build something great?**
If you’re excited by the opportunity to help existing businesses get more value from a self-serve product, and you have the craft, curiosity, commercial thinking, and autonomy to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

**Unleash Your Potential**
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

London
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.
Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

As our Senior Finance Business Partner (Drug Design and Development), you will serve as the dedicated partner to our drug discovery organisation for both strategic and operational finance. **The team..**
The Record to Report (RTR) function operates at the core of Finance Operations, maintaining overall accounting integrity and driving continuous process improvements across ITV’s global entities. Within RTR, the Intercompany team takes ownership of complex global reconciliations, net balance reporting, and settlement procedures. Operating in a digital-first, collaborative shared services environment, our team thrives on automation, standardisation, and driving a non-blame culture while supporting major organisational changes, including the M&E separation.
**The role..**
We’re looking for a RTR Manager - Intercompany to join our team on a 12-month fixed-term contract basis. Reporting directly to the Head of RTR, you will lead an intercompany team of 2 direct reports (RTR Accountants and Assistant Accountants).

Some of your key day-to-day responsibilities will include:
* Managing and delivering timely, accurate Oracle Fusion intercompany accounting activities to ensure smooth month-end and year-end closes.
* Performing detailed intercompany reconciliations across UK Fusion entities, rigorously investigating and resolving complex variances and discrepancies.
* Processing intercompany settlement and elimination journals within the Oracle Fusion ERP system and Oracle Intercompany Workbench.
* Ensuring intercompany processes are consistent, fully compliant, efficient, and aligned with accounting standards and internal control frameworks.
* Acting as a key point of contact for external audit activities, providing intercompany documentation and technical explanations.
* Championing standardisation and automation by testing regular ERP SaaS releases, leveraging Oracle Fusion capabilities, and optimising close activities.
* Line managing and developing a team of 2, conducting regular 1-2-1s and performance reviews aligned with Finance Operations strategy.
* Supporting the Head of Department (HoD) on ad-hoc intercompany projects, analysis, and cross-pillar operational support as needed.
**Skills you’ll need** (minimum criteria)
* Fully qualified accountant (ICAEW / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) with extensive post-qualification experience (PQE).
* Proven, in-depth intercompany accounting experience with a deep understanding of complex reconciliations and settlement procedures.
* Proficiency in accounting software, with direct experience using Oracle Fusion ERP highly preferred.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a proven ability to work accurately under tight month-end close deadlines.
* Excited by and supportive of process automation, digital thinking, and systems-led solutions.
* Excellent communication skills to foster a collaborative, non-blame culture across cross-functional teams.
**Other things we’re looking for** (key criteria)
* Experience working within an RTR team during a digital transformation, with a track record of innovative problem-solving.
* Comfortable navigating uncertainty, organisational change, and evolving priorities.
* Alignment with core ITV behaviors: Inspire performance, Empowering with accountability, Welcoming new perspectives, Spend wisely & save widely, and Make fast informed decisions.

* Flexibility in working hours is required to meet key deliverables during critical reporting periods, such as month-end and year-end closes.
* Supporting across other RTR pillars during periods of absence or when management support is needed.

Failing drives, deleted files, machines that will not boot with a lifetime of photos inside. The day
## What the work actually is.
Imaging first, always: the original drive is evidence, the copy is the workbench. Your day moves between logical recoveries, failing mechanical drives that get one good read if they get any, and the conversations that come with them, because the person on the phone is not asking about a drive, they are asking about their photographs.
Some days end with everything back. Some end with you explaining, carefully, what is gone. Both have to be done well, and the second one is the reason this role needs a particular kind of person.
What you bring
## You.
Deep familiarity with filesystems, storage hardware and imaging tools, and the discipline to work on copies without exception. You can explain risk in plain English before work starts, you never promise what the hardware has not agreed to, and you treat a stranger's files with the privacy you would want for your own.
**In one line:** Methodical before anything else, fluent in filesystems and failure modes, and comfortable refusing risky work.

# B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator
We usually respond within three days
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
We’re looking for an organised, commercially minded and proactive B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator to join our Wholesale team, supporting the continued growth of our B2B business across our four global brands: Joma Jewellery, A Littles & Co, Katie Loxton and Katie Loxton Inc.
Working closely with our B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider commercial team, you’ll play a key role in coordinating day-to-day B2B marketing activity, supporting sales operations and helping us maximise opportunities across our wholesale channels.
You will make an impact by coordinating B2B sales and marketing activity across our global brands and territories, supporting new season launches, campaigns and promotions, and ensuring our sales channels and customer-facing platforms remain accurate and up to date. You’ll also support our Sales Agent network with day-to-day queries, reporting, prospecting and sales administration, helping to identify and maximise opportunities for commercial growth.
Acting as a central point of communication across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Customer Experience, Operations and Events, you’ll help ensure activity is aligned and delivered smoothly. This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in sales, marketing or commercial coordination who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is looking to develop their career within a growing global fashion and lifestyle business.
The role is Monday - Friday 9am-5pm. You'll enjoy the exciting buzz of our friendly office in Banbury, Oxfordshire three times a week on average with the flexibility to work from home for the remaining two days. This may increase to 5 days a week during peak periods.
**BEHIND THE BRANDS**
We’re a family-run, entrepreneurial company with an exciting pace of life and a bright and friendly team. We are passionate about creating stunning products with a personal touch and innovating our business behind the scenes. We value creativity, collaboration and integrity. **HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**
* Supporting the B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider Wholesale team to drive commercial growth, strengthen Sales Agent performance and maximise opportunities to achieve and exceed agreed sales targets.
* Coordinating and executing the B2B marketing calendar across all territories, ensuring activity is aligned with the wider wholesale strategy and commercial objectives.
* Supporting the delivery of new season launches, coordinating sales tools including brochures, training materials, creative assets, emails, app content and website updates.
* Coordinating B2B email marketing campaigns, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered on schedule.
* Monitoring and maintaining the B2B sales app, ensuring product categories, collections, pricing, imagery and stock availability are accurate and up to date.
* Maintaining and regularly auditing B2B websites, ensuring product listings, seasonal campaigns and category pages are accurate and complete.
* Partnering with the Customer Experience team to support Sales Agents with day-to-day queries and ensure prompt resolution.
* Assisting with reporting and analysing sales performance, campaign results, customer engagement and website activity to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Identifying new wholesale marketing opportunities and initiatives to support sales growth, including reviewing new stockist enquiries before sharing with Sales Agents.
* Monitoring competitor activity, industry trends and customer feedback, sharing relevant insights and opportunities with the wider team.
* Ensuring sales and marketing information remains accurate and consistent across internal systems and customer-facing platforms, applying appropriate regional spelling, terminology and product information.
* Coordinating trade press advertising briefs, including supporting additional editorial opportunities and features.
* Supporting the Wholesale and Events teams with sales and marketing requirements for owned stores and external stockists, including imagery, assets, showroom presentations, events and invitations.
* Building strong working relationships across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Operations, Customer Experience and the Sales Agent network to support effective communication and delivery of commercial objectives.
* Providing sales administration support across the UK and EU Sales Agent network, including sales performance and gaps reporting, prospecting support, new stockist enquiries and showroom coordination.
* Undertaking additional projects and responsibilities to support the continued growth of the wholesale channel.
**THE TALENT YOU'LL BRING**
* Previous experience within a B2B Sales, Marketing or Commercial Coordinator/Assistant role.
* A strong understanding of sales processes and marketing principles, with good commercial awareness.
* Experience maintaining product information and data, ideally across customer-facing sales or ecommerce platforms.
* Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with product information, pricing and written content.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across multiple teams and external partners.
* A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to take ownership and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel; experience with CRM, ERP or sales management systems would be advantageous.
* Experience within the fashion, lifestyle or jewellery industry would be desirable but isn't essential.
* A highly motivated, collaborative and positive can-do attitude, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
**PERFECTLY PACKAGED**
* A salary of up to £32,000
* 33 days holiday including bank holidays rising to 35 with length of service
* A broad benefits package including our staff favourite – a very generous staff discount across both our brands. See all of our benefits on our careers portal
* Opportunities to make an impact as well as learn and develop further
* An innovative and friendly workplace with a team we’re proud to be part of. Find out more about us and our culture on our careers portal

# Deputy Editor - UNILAD
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.
The Deputy Brand Editor will work closely with the Brand Editor across both editorial and social to help shape and deliver LADbible’s daily content agenda.
Sitting at the heart of the LADbible newsroom, they will manage the day-to-day publishing of content and set content priorities across breaking news, original journalism, search and culturally relevant stories alongside the brand editor.
The Deputy Brand Editor will take a hands-on role in commissioning, editing and publishing content, ensuring it meets LADbible’s standards for accuracy, quality, tone and legal compliance. They will use performance data, audience insights and platform trends to inform editorial decisions.
They will also deputise for the Brand Editor when required.
**Key responsibilities**
* Work closely with the Brand Editor across editorial and social to agree daily priorities, coordinate coverage and ensure a consistent brand voice across platforms.
* Deputise for the Brand Editor when required, providing editorial leadership and making confident publishing decisions.
* Commission, edit and publish news content, including breaking news, trending stories, original journalism and search-led articles.
* Work closely with the audience team to identify opportunities to inform commissioning and forward planning.
* Head up planning and tracking of original journalism and exclusive stories
* Maintain high standards of editorial judgement, storytelling, accuracy, sourcing and media-law compliance.
* Identify potential legal, regulatory and reputational risks before publication, escalating sensitive or complex matters to the Head of Editorial when appropriate.
* Use audience insights, search trends and platform behaviour to inform daily publishing decisions and longer-term content planning.
* Monitor performance through tools including Aperture, Chartbeat, Google Analytics and Mission Control, using findings to optimise coverage.
* Work with the Brand Editor to deliver monthly targets for overall sessions, search traffic and revenue, as set by the Head of Editorial.
* Agree individual reporter KPIs with the Head of Editorial and hold regular performance and development meetings.
* Champion LADbible’s editorial voice, tone and standards across all output.
* Ensure content is culturally relevant, distinctive and aligned with audience interests.
* Manage and participate in the team rota, ensuring appropriate staffing for evenings, weekends, major events and periods of increased news activity.
**Required skills and experience**
* Significant experience in digital publishing, preferably within a fast-paced newsroom and in an editorial leadership role.
* Proven experience managing, motivating and developing a team of journalists.
* Strong commissioning and news-editing experience, with the ability to improve copy, headlines, structure and story framing.
* A strong working knowledge of media law, editorial compliance and the legal risks associated with digital publishing.
* Confidence handling legally sensitive stories and knowing when further legal or senior editorial guidance is required.
* Experience using performance data to inform commissioning, publishing and content-planning decisions.
* Experience setting objectives, managing performance and providing actionable feedback.
* Strong communication, organisation and team-coordination skills.
* The ability to adapt quickly to changing workflows, developing stories and fast-moving priorities.
* Experience fostering a collaborative, inclusive and creative newsroom culture.
At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.
LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

## Who **We Are**
Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.
Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.
We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.
## The Way We Work
The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:
* **Move with Urgency:** We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
* **Take Ownership:** We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
* **Communicate Openly:** We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
* **Build Great Teams:** We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
* **Raise the Bar:** We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
* **Think Long-Term:** We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
## **What We're Looking For**
Lightning AI is seeking an experienced **Senior Infrastructure Operations Engineers** to help scale and operate our next-generation AI infrastructure platform. Our InfraOps team sits at the center of reliability, automation, and operational scale for GPU infrastructure. This team owns break/fix operations, incident response, customer provisioning, observability, and the automation systems that keep complex infrastructure running efficiently.
In this role, you’ll work hands-on with large-scale GPU environments, Linux systems, bare metal infrastructure, provisioning workflows, and platform reliability. You’ll partner closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Network Operations, and Software Platform teams to troubleshoot issues, improve operational efficiency, and build automation that reduces manual toil over time.
*This role may be fully remote within the UK, or hybrid out of one of our London office hub, with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide work visa sponsorship for this position at this time.*
## **What You'll Do**
* At the direction of the Manager of Infrastructure Operations, design, build, and roll out new platforms and patterns to minimize incidents and enable customer facing and internal features.
* Deploy updates and improvements to support both Lightning AI's internal and end customer use cases.
* Collaborate with colleagues in Infrastructure Engineering, Network Operations, Customer Success and Software and Platform Development Teams.
* Participate in the on-call rotation which is evenly distributed across all team members in a primary / secondary pattern where you are primary then move to a secondary position.
## **What You Will Need**
### **Required Qualifications**
* 8+ years working with Linux as a server / hosting platform, extra points for Ubuntu experience.
* 5+ years experience with AWS.
* 2+ years experience with Kubernetes and strong container fundamentals.
* 2+ years experience with Terraform and Ansible
* 2+ years with network attached storage management (via NFS, ceph, or other protocols). Extra points for experience with VAST storage systems.
* Experience with monitoring systems (Prometheus, ELK stack).
* Familiarity with the gitops workflow.
* Software development experience using Python, Go, bash, or other languages for the purposes of automation & connecting systems & APIs together.
* Deep networking fundamentals, extra points for experience with datacenter level networks, 400Gb ethernet, and Infiniband.
* Experience building and delivering complex systems.
* Effective at navigating tradeoffs between design, risk, cost, and outcomes.
* Comfortable with navigating ambiguity.
* Strong written and oral communication.
### **Nice-to-Haves**
* Experience with bare metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, extra points for working with Dell hardware.
* Experience with GPU servers, both in bare metal form or under virtualization.
* Deep experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls and Juniper Networks as vendors.
* Experience with VAST storage systems

### **1. Program and Volume Delivery**
* **Delivery planning:** Own end-to-end program plans, from pilot and calibration through scaled production and final delivery, aligning scope, staffing, and milestones with customer requirements.
* **Tracking and forecasting:** Monitor output against volume and timeline targets, forecast delivery using actual performance, and adjust capacity or workflows to address gaps.
* **Program milestones:** Lead readiness reviews, quality checkpoints, and acceptance milestones, coordinating stakeholders and driving timely decisions.
* **Budget and margin:** Manage delivery costs against budget and margin targets; proactively flag scope changes, cost pressures, and resource trade-offs.

* **Align capacity:** Align team capacity and capabilities with program goals.
* **Enable performance:** Foster strong performance through clear expectations, training, and feedback.

The Manager, Technology Risk & Controls is accountable for leading technology risk, control and regulatory compliance activities across Regulatory Reporting Solutions Engineering. ## Technology Risk & Control Management
Support the identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of technology, cyber and resilience risks across products, platforms, services and third-party dependencies.
Coordinate risk and control activities to ensure risks are appropriately recorded, assessed and managed in accordance with internal policies and standards.
Facilitate regular reviews of risk mitigation plans, ensuring actions, issues and control gaps are tracked through to completion.
Contribute to the maintenance and continuous improvement of technology risk frameworks, control standards and supporting processes.
Provide constructive challenge on control effectiveness, evidence quality and risk treatment approaches.
## Regulatory Compliance & Oversight
Support implementation of technology, cyber security and operational resilience requirements applicable to Regulatory Reporting Solutions, including DORA obligations and relevant regulatory reporting expectations.
Assist in translating regulatory obligations into practical control requirements and governance processes.
Coordinate evidence gathering and responses for regulatory reviews, ICT risk management assessments, SOC 2 assurance and internal audit activity.
Escalate emerging compliance risks, control weaknesses and potential breaches in a timely manner.
Maintain awareness of relevant regulatory developments and industry best practice.
## Operational Resilience
Embed operational resilience requirements within Regulatory Reporting Solutions engineering, technology, production and change activities.
Contribute to resilience assessments, scenario testing, control validation and remediation activities.
Coordinate resilience-related actions, evidence and reporting to demonstrate compliance with internal and external requirements.
Work with engineering, production management, cyber, infrastructure and business stakeholders to strengthen resilience across regulated reporting services and supporting platforms.

Monitor and report on key risk indicators, control metrics and remediation progress.

Ensure risk data remains accurate, complete and appropriately evidenced.

Coordinate technology risk assessments, control reviews and thematic risk activities.
Support the identification, recording and assessment of technology, cyber and resilience risks.
Track remediation plans for risk events, audit findings, control deficiencies and regulatory actions.
Provide oversight of action delivery, challenging delays and escalating concerns where required.
Ensure remediation activities are appropriately evidenced and sustainably implemented.

Support oversight of technology suppliers, cloud services and other critical dependencies from a risk and control perspective.
Coordinate due diligence, assurance reviews and risk assessments relating to third-party services.
Monitor remediation activity arising from supplier reviews and control assessments.
Promote alignment with enterprise standards relating to cloud, supplier and technology risk management.
Maintain effective stakeholder relationships to support the management of dependency-related risks.

Act as a trusted partner to engineering, product and technology teams on risk and control matters.
Provide practical guidance to support risk-informed decision making and delivery outcomes.
Build effective relationships across first-line, second-line and assurance functions.
Communicate complex risk and regulatory topics clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Promote a strong risk and control culture through collaboration, coaching and constructive challenge.

Degree or equivalent professional experience.
Relevant certifications such as CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ITIL or similar.

Proven experience supporting regulatory engagement, audits, and governance forums.
Strong understanding of technology control frameworks, cyber security risk, and operational resilience concepts.

Knowledge of regulatory reporting services, including trade repository and approved reporting mechanism environments, is desirable.
Experience working in or supporting regulated reporting services, Financial Market Infrastructure or regulated information services.
Familiarity with cloud, third‐party risk, and data resilience control environments.

**About the Role**
We are seeking a **Business Process Analyst** to join the Digitalisation Centre of Excellence within DSM at LSEG. This role sits at the heart of **process discovery, automation opportunity exploration**, and **digital transformation**, helping shape well‐defined, data‐driven use cases that feed into our engineering workstreams.
You will analyse real‐world operational processes, triangulating between documentation, system data, process mining insights, and interviews with business teams. Your goal is to surface inefficiencies, uncover automation and AI enhancements, and translate them into clear, structured problem statements the engineering teams can act on.
This is a hands‐on, discovery‐focused role suited to someone who enjoys digging into how work really happens in practice, engaging closely with DSM Business Services, operational SMEs, Business Architects, and engineering leads in Data Engineering, Analytics, ML, and AI.
The role enables stronger clarity, alignment, and adoption of Digitalisation initiatives across DSM.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Process Analysis**
* Analyse end‐to‐end operational workflows, including manual steps, handoffs, approvals, exceptions, and rework loops.
* Combine process artefacts, interviews, and direct operational insight to understand how work is performed in practice, not just how it is documented.
* Engage with SMEs to uncover bottlenecks, challenges, and workarounds not easily visible in system logs.
* Detect inefficiencies, recurring manual effort, and areas where digital improvements could have real impact.
**Data‐Driven Discovery & Insight**
* Use SQL to explore operational datasets and quantify volumes, patterns, exceptions, and constraints.
* Use Python (e.g., Pandas) for lightweight analytical exploration to support hypothesis testing and prioritisation.
* Create simple Power BI visualisations to support discovery discussions.
* Where available, interpret **process mining outputs** (e.g., Celonis, QPR, Power Automate Process Mining) to validate real‐world execution paths and uncover hidden variants.
* Combine qualitative process understanding with quantitative insight to strengthen use‐case discovery.
**Automation & Use‐Case Discovery**
* Spot areas for workflow and rules‐based automation, analytics enhancements, data‐driven decision support, or ML/AI augmentation (in collaboration with engineering).
* Assess each potential enhancement using structured criteria including impact, feasibility, suitability, dependencies, and constraints.
* Support the Digitalisation intake, discovery and assessment process, ensuring opportunities are consistently evaluated, documented and prioritised before entering delivery.
* Quantify expected business value, effort, complexity and implementation considerations to support prioritisation decisions.
* Translate discoveries into delivery‐ready use cases, including:
+ Clear problem statements
+ Scope and assumptions
+ Expected benefits
+ Risks and constraints
+ Success metrics and value logic
* Define and baseline operational KPIs to support opportunity assessment and post-implementation value tracking.
**As‐Is → To‐Be Translation**
* Create clear as‐is process maps and to‐be digital/automation concepts (BPMN or equivalent).
* Clearly articulate what will change, what will remain, and where automation or AI will be applied.
* Provide contextualised, well‐scoped inputs to engineering teams to support effective design and delivery.
**Prioritisation Support**
* Contribute input to a prioritised pipeline of initiatives based on business impact, complexity, dependencies, and readiness.
* Use simple prioritisation methods (e.g., impact vs effort) to support structured decision‐making.
* Help determine the most appropriate engineering workstream for each use case.
**Operating Model Communication**
* Produce clear, concise visualisations of processes, operating models, and future‐state workflows.
* Prepare communication materials and presentations that explain use cases, benefits, and expected changes in accessible, non‐technical language.
* Support alignment sessions by helping teams understand how processes and roles may evolve.

* Act as a feedback channel between business users and engineering teams during early rollout.
* Track intended vs realised outcomes and capture insights and lessons learned.
* Contribute to internal narratives articulating the value delivered by Digitalisation.
**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**
* Work closely with DSM Business Services, operational SMEs, Business Architects, and engineering teams.
* Maintain a structured view of analysed processes and discovered enhancements.
* Contribute to improving templates, discovery approaches, prioritisation methods, and ways of working.
**How This Role Fits into Delivery**
This role operates **upstream** of engineering, strengthening discovery, clarity, and alignment. By providing high‐quality, well‐scoped problem definitions and validated opportunities, the role helps ensure Digitalisation initiatives are:
* Easier to deliver
* Better understood
* Faster to adopt
* Aligned to real business needs

* Processes are understood at execution level, not just theoretical or documented level.

## **Role Purpose**
To provide effective administrative, procurement and compliance support to the maintenance and facilities function, ensuring that planned maintenance, statutory inspections, contractor activities, purchase orders, records and compliance documentation are accurately controlled and maintained.
The role will support the safe, reliable and compliant operation of site infrastructure, critical utilities, production areas and building services.

### **Maintenance Administration**
* Maintain accurate maintenance records, schedules and documentation.
* Coordinate planned preventative maintenance activities and follow up outstanding actions.
* Update the Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) or maintenance tracker.
* Monitor maintenance completion, overdue tasks and recurring failures.
* Support the preparation of weekly and monthly maintenance reports.
* Maintain asset registers, equipment information and maintenance histories.
* Track spare parts, service reports, certificates and operating manuals.
* Support the planning and coordination of maintenance shutdowns and site interruptions.
### **Purchase Orders and Procurement**
* Raise purchase orders for maintenance, facilities, compliance and contractor requirements.

* Check that correct cost centres, project codes and approval routes are used.

* Track purchase orders through to completion and confirm delivery of goods or services.
* Support the matching of purchase orders, delivery notes, invoices and service reports.
* Monitor outstanding commitments and highlight potential budget issues.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and provide regular updates on open orders.
* Assist with obtaining quotations and comparing supplier proposals where required.
* Ensure emergency or urgent purchases are appropriately documented and authorised.
### **Compliance and Statutory Inspections**

* Coordinate inspections, testing and certification for safety-critical and legally required equipment.
* Ensure inspection reports and certificates are received, reviewed and filed correctly.
* Monitor expiry dates and escalate overdue or non-compliant activities.
* Maintain evidence for internal, customer and external audits.
* Support compliance with applicable health and safety, environmental and facilities legislation.

* Ensure work affecting production, tools or critical services is correctly authorised through the WPS process.

* Support investigations into equipment failures, repeat defects and compliance issues.
* Maintain controlled copies of procedures, inspection records and operating documentation.

## **Role Purpose**
The Contractor Manager is responsible for the safe, compliant and effective management of all contractors working on the Lumentum Caswell site.
The role will ensure contractors are properly approved, inducted, competent and controlled, with all work completed in accordance with Lumentum standards, site procedures, approved RAMS, permits and production requirements.
The Contractor Manager will support the WPS Maintenance Manager in maintaining a safe, reliable and well-controlled working environment across production areas, cleanrooms, critical utilities, buildings and infrastructure.
## **Key Responsibilities**
### **Contractor Control and Governance**
* Manage the complete contractor lifecycle, from pre-qualification and onboarding through to completion and offboarding.
* Ensure all contractors have the required approvals, competencies, insurance, training and documentation before attending site.
* Maintain accurate contractor records, including RAMS, permits, training certificates, insurance and performance reviews.
* Ensure contractors are fully briefed on site rules, emergency arrangements, security requirements and operational restrictions.
* Prevent unapproved or unbooked contractors from commencing work unless the work is business-critical and express permission has been granted by the Site Lead.
* Ensure unapproved contractors are continuously supervised on a one-to-one basis where permission has been granted.
### **Health, Safety and Compliance**
* Ensure contractor activities comply with Lumentum health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Review and approve RAMS in conjunction with relevant WPS and technical stakeholders.
* Ensure suitable permits are in place, including hot-work, confined-space, electrical isolation, work-at-height and fire-system impairment permits.
* Verify that contractors use appropriate PPE, tools, equipment and control measures.
* Conduct contractor audits, site inspections and regular compliance reviews.
* Investigate contractor incidents, near misses, unsafe acts and non-compliances.
* Ensure corrective actions are recorded, assigned and closed within agreed timescales.
* Support statutory compliance and maintain suitable records for audit purposes.
### **Planning and Coordination**
* Coordinate contractor activities to minimise disruption to production, cleanrooms, laboratories, offices and site services.
* Ensure all planned interruptions are reviewed and approved through the WPS process.
* Require Green-to-Green plans for work that may affect production, tools, utilities or critical infrastructure.
* Confirm that ramp-down, work execution and ramp-up requirements are understood before work begins.
* Coordinate contractor access, work areas, materials, isolations, deliveries and waste removal.
* Ensure contractors do not interfere with operational activities or critical site systems without formal approval.
### **Site and Project Support**
* Support maintenance, facilities, capital projects, cleanroom works and infrastructure upgrades.
* Work closely with WPS, Engineering, Facilities, Production, EHS, Security, Procurement and Project Management.
* Assist with contractor tendering, scope reviews, mobilisation and performance management.
* Review contractor programmes and identify resource, access, safety or operational risks.
* Support the delivery of projects in accordance with agreed scope, cost, quality and schedule requirements.
* Ensure completed works are inspected, documented and formally handed over to Lumentum.
### **Contractor Performance Management**
* Establish clear expectations for contractor performance, conduct and customer service.
* Monitor contractor delivery against agreed KPIs, service levels and contractual requirements.
* Lead regular contractor review meetings and performance discussions.
* Address poor performance, repeated non-compliance and unsafe behaviour promptly.
* Support the Senior WPS Manager with contractor escalation, commercial discussions and improvement plans.
* Promote a professional, respectful and collaborative relationship with contractors while maintaining appropriate control.
### **Communication and Reporting**
* Provide regular updates to the Senior WPS Manager on contractor activity, performance, risks and upcoming works.
* Maintain a contractor activity schedule and site attendance records.
* Produce reports covering compliance, incidents, permits, audits, interruptions and corrective actions.
* Communicate planned works clearly to affected stakeholders.
* Escalate any activity that presents a risk to people, production, cleanrooms, critical utilities, compliance or business continuity.
## **Key Performance Indicators**
* 100% of contractors approved and inducted before starting work.
* 100% of required RAMS, permits, competencies and insurance records available and current.
* Zero unapproved contractor access or uncontrolled contractor activities.
* Contractor audits and inspections completed to the agreed schedule.
* Corrective actions closed within agreed timescales.
* No avoidable production interruptions caused by contractor activities.
* All planned interruptions supported by an approved Green-to-Green plan.
* Improved contractor safety, compliance, quality and service performance.
* Accurate and timely contractor reporting.
* Positive feedback from WPS, Production, Engineering and site stakeholders.
## **Experience and Qualifications**
### **Essential**
* Experience managing contractors in a manufacturing, engineering, facilities, construction, pharmaceutical, semiconductor or similar controlled environment.
* Good understanding of contractor management, RAMS, permits and site safety requirements.
* Experience coordinating multiple contractors and activities within a live operational environment.
* Strong understanding of health, safety and environmental responsibilities.
* Ability to challenge unsafe or non-compliant behaviour professionally.
* Strong organisational, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Competent in Microsoft Office and contractor-management or reporting systems.
### **Desirable**
* NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent safety qualification.
* IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent.
* Construction or facilities-management qualification.
* SMSTS, SSSTS or equivalent contractor-management training.
* Experience working in cleanrooms, laboratories, critical utilities or semiconductor manufacturing.
* Experience with permit-to-work systems, isolations and planned production interruptions.
* Experience supporting capital projects and maintenance programmes.
## **Personal Attributes**
* Safety-focused and willing to challenge poor standards.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented.
* Calm and decisive under pressure.
* Professional, approachable and fair.
* Strong communicator with the confidence to work at all levels.
* Commercially aware and focused on value.
* Collaborative and customer-focused.
* Able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Committed to continuous improvement and high standards of delivery.
## **Authority and Accountability**
The Contractor Manager is authorised to stop contractor work where there is an immediate risk to safety, compliance, production, critical utilities or the site environment.
The role is accountable for ensuring that contractor activities are properly planned, approved, controlled and completed in accordance with Lumentum requirements and the direction of the Senior WPS Manager.

Meta is seeking a Security Engineering Manager to lead a team of domain experts in our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. The team spans security, privacy, and trust and safety, and its mandate is to solve hard, real-world problems in those domains and turn the expert reasoning behind those solutions into the signal that improves what AI systems are capable of. Improved models ship back to the engineering and operations teams who do this work at Meta, so your team's output compounds: it raises the capability of both the models and the practitioners who depend on them.
As a manager here you are accountable for two things at once. The first is your team: health, engagement, growth, and performance for a group of experienced practitioners. The second is the technical output: the volume, quality, and complexity of the expert signal your team produces, prioritized against the capability gaps that matter most. You will also keep a hand in the work itself, because in this environment credibility with your team comes from current domain judgment rather than from past experience.
This is an applied research environment at an early stage. The problems are real and high priority, the road is not fully paved, and problem selection sits with the domain experts rather than being handed down. It is a strong fit for a manager who is energized by that and a poor fit for someone who wants a settled roadmap and a stable problem set.

## Description
### About Moonbug Labs
Moonbug Labs is Moonbug Entertainment's internal innovation function, built to move quickly on ideas that help the rest of the business work better with data and AI. We sit inside Platforms & Music, and our job is to turn the scale of Moonbug's business across shows like CoComelon, Blippi, Little Angel and Morphle into things the whole company can use: data, tools and AI systems that take on real tasks.
We don't build one kind of thing. In any given week the team might ship a data pipeline, stand up a dashboard, prototype a AI workflow, automate a manual process, or build an operational tool that a whole department ends up relying on. What ties it together is the stack rather than the output: large language model (LLM) agents, retrieval and knowledge systems, analytical data infrastructure (we run heavily on ClickHouse and BigQuery), and tooling built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which lets AI agents connect to the systems we actually use.
We're a small team that ships fast and prototypes in days rather than weeks. Rough but working beats polished and untested.
### About the Program
This is a graduate program for people at the start of their career, whether you're coming straight out of a degree or deliberately changing track into tech and data. We hire for attitude first. We'd rather take someone entrepreneurial, curious and quick to figure things out than someone who ticks every technical box on paper but waits to be told what to do.
We're also not looking to hire five of the same person. The team has a mix of strengths and we want the program to reflect that. Some people who join us will lean toward software engineering. Others will head for data engineering, infrastructure and DevOps, BI and analytics, security, or building AI agents specifically. If one of those disciplines excites you and you want to go deep, that's a great fit. If you're a generalist who wants a bit of everything, that works too. What matters is the energy and drive you bring to whatever you pick up.
### What you'll actually be doing
* Working on AI agent tooling: building and integrating connectors that let AI agents reach more of the systems and data sources across the business.
* Rapidly prototyping internal tools: taking a rough idea (a dashboard, an alert, an agent that automates something manual) from sketch to working demo in days, not weeks.
* Turning manual processes into reusable tools: spotting repetitive, one-off work across teams and building a lightweight fix, whether that's a script, an internal app or an AI agent.
* Working directly with data pipelines: querying and validating data in our warehouse and document stores, helping debug ingestion issues, and building lightweight data quality tooling.
* Prototyping and iterating on AI agents: contributing to pieces like extraction logic, evaluation harnesses, and guardrail and access-control checks, under the team's guidance rather than owning a full production system solo.
## Requirements
### What we're looking for
We care far more about how you think and work than about ticking every box below, but there is a baseline we're looking for:
Core ability
* Comfortable reading and writing code, with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript the most useful to us, and enough fundamentals to debug something rather than accept whatever a tool hands you.
* Solid SQL fundamentals (joins, aggregations, window functions). A lot of our work sits on top of a data warehouse, so this matters whichever discipline you lean toward.
* Some familiarity with git and version control, and an instinct for keeping your work reproducible rather than stuck on your local machine.
Comfort with modern AI tooling
* Hands-on experience building with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. It doesn't need to be professional experience; side projects and scrappy builds count.
* Enough prompt engineering knowledge to get reliable output, and the judgement to check AI-generated work for correctness and mistakes rather than shipping it blind
* Familiarity with concepts like embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents and context windows.
Good to have, not required
* A basic sense of how data warehousing works
* Awareness of API integration patterns and the basics of OAuth and access control
* Interest in or experience with the YouTube platform and its APIs, or with music and rights data. Given the space we work in, this is a real plus.
* Any interest in or exposure to media, entertainment or children's content data
* Comfort with agent- and connector-driven ways of working, since much of what we build isn't a classic linear pipeline
How you like to work
* You'd rather ship something rough and iterate than polish a spec no one has tested.
* You bring your own drive and ideas instead of waiting for a fully specified brief.
* You're comfortable with ambiguous or half-written requirements, and your instinct is to ask a good clarifying question rather than stall.
We're looking for curiosity, initiative and an entrepreneurial streak, not a finished specialist. Whatever your strengths across engineering, data, AI or analysis, if you're excited to build, we'd love to hear from you.

## Your Team Responsibilities
MSCI is building a platform to discover, access and monetise both MSCI-proprietary and third-party datasets for systematic and quantitative investors. The Data Scout drives the discovery engine: finding new and interesting external and alternative data sources, researching their relevance and applicability, and building and qualifying the vendor pipeline. The discipline is not simply finding data, but finding data that is relevant and additive — sources that give MSCI and its clients either genuinely new insight or a sharper lens on existing analysis. The role works in close partnership with the Head of Data Product, who leads the senior decision-making and the direct negotiation of key commercial terms; the Scout provides the research, vendor relationships and dataset evaluation that make those decisions and deals possible, and contributes directly to MarketPlace revenue and product relevance.

Quality and depth of the vendor pipeline — conversations initiated, opportunities qualified, and well-prepared deals brought forward for decision.

**Discovery & research**
* Proactively scout new and interesting external and alternative data sources across the major categories (e.g. transactional, ESG, web & app, sentiment, location, fund flows, satellite, economic), prioritising those that are relevant and additive to quant and systematic workflows.
