Statkraft is Europe's largest generator of renewable energy from hydro, wind and solar power. We have around 6,200 employees in 20 countries. We have been making clean energy possible for over 130 years, with unrivalled expertise in supplying the world with what it needs most. We envision a world that runs entirely on renewable energy.
As a Senior Grid Engineer – Power Systems & Compliance, you will support the technical delivery, grid integration and compliance of Statkraft’s renewable energy and grid services portfolio, including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), synchronous condensers, solar PV, wind and hybrid/co-located projects.
Reporting to the Technical Manager – Grid Services UK, you will act as the day-to-day technical lead for assigned grid, power systems and compliance workstreams, working closely with project teams, consultants, OEMs, contractors and network operators.
## Job Description
* Lead and manage Grid Code and G99 compliance activities, translating connection and regulatory requirements into clear technical deliverables, compliance strategies and project programmes.
* Manage projects through power system studies, modelling, technical submissions, commissioning, compliance testing and final compliance acceptance, including EON, ION and FON processes where applicable.
* Define, coordinate and review power system study programmes, including load flow, fault level, reactive power, harmonics, power quality, stability, RMS, EMT and control interaction studies.
* Review and challenge consultant and OEM study methodologies, assumptions, models and results, assessing their impact on plant design, controls, commissioning and compliance.
* Manage technical engagement with NESO, Transmission Owners and DNOs, coordinating technical submissions, responses, evidence and compliance close-out activities.
* Define and review plant control and integration requirements, including PPC/MPPC, EMS, BESS and grid-forming controls, AVR systems, synchronous condenser controls and network operator interfaces.
* Support the wider technical ownership and integration of BESS and synchronous condenser projects, while leading grid connection, power system performance and compliance activities for wind and solar projects.
* Work closely with Project Managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams to identify and manage technical, programme and commercial risks, review designs and contractor submissions, and support procurement and tender evaluations.
* Provide technical leadership throughout design, construction and commissioning, assessing the compliance impact of design or equipment changes and supporting the resolution of complex technical issues.
* Provide clear, practical and commercially aware engineering recommendations, supporting project handover into operations and providing technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
## Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced power systems professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a pragmatic approach to project delivery and is confident challenging consultants, OEMs and contractors.
* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* Strong experience within transmission-connected generation, energy storage, grid support technologies or major distribution-connected projects, with experience of Grid Code, G99 and network compliance.
* Strong understanding of the GB Grid Code, with experience managing projects through power system studies, commissioning, compliance testing and final compliance acceptance.
* Demonstrable experience specifying, managing and reviewing power system studies and models, with the technical capability to challenge methodologies, assumptions, results and recommendations.
* Strong knowledge of voltage and reactive power control, frequency response, fault ride-through, fault levels, system stability, harmonics and power quality.
* Experience managing technical interfaces between consultants, OEMs, EPC contractors and network operators, alongside a good understanding of HV substations, transformers, protection, metering and control systems.
* Experience with one or more relevant technologies, including BESS, synchronous condensers, wind, solar PV or converter-based generation; hybrid/co-located and grid-forming BESS experience would be advantageous.
* Experience with RMS and EMT models and tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, PSS®E or equivalent is desirable, although hands-on modelling expertise is not essential.
* Knowledge or experience of NESO and DNO compliance processes, EON/ION/FON, UK standards and 132 kV, 275 kV and/or 400 kV connections would be advantageous.
* Strong technical communication, stakeholder management and decision-making skills, with the confidence to work independently, challenge technical assumptions and escalate significant issues when required; Chartered Engineer status or progress towards CEng would be advantageous.

A career with Statkraft is a career filled with purpose – meaning that every employee is not just making a living, they are making a real difference to the planet, our communities, and the future. With us, you’ll shape a career that is truly forward-facing with many amazing opportunities and offerings to match. This includes:

* A working environment characterized by competence, responsibility, innovation and a strong commercial culture

* The chance to grow your career alongside a truly global network of experts, leaders, specialists and graduates from different countries and background

# Sales Development Representative - January 2027 Intake
London, England, United Kingdom
Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach.
Our concept, “Technology, done differently”, embodies our belief that the way our customers consume and utilize technology should innovate at the same pace as the technology itself.
Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.
Techary have helped customers scale their operations globally, gain an advantage in financial markets, enabled mission-critical projects and, most importantly, implemented technology that delivers alpha-accelerating business transformation.
### ### The Role
We are looking for ambitious and commercially minded Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to join Techary as part of our January 2027 intake.
Techary is a fast-growing global technology business, working with customers ranging from ambitious scale-ups to some of the world’s largest financial services and enterprise organisations. With teams across the UK, US, Europe and Asia, we are continuing to invest in our sales function as we scale globally.
As an SDR, you will be at the front end of that growth, focused on identifying new opportunities, building relationships and opening doors into large enterprise organisations.
You will learn how to break into complex accounts, identify the people who influence technology decisions and create opportunities with organisations that may never have engaged with Techary before.
Using a combination of cold calling, email, networking and intelligent account research, you will identify target organisations, understand their technology environment and engage senior decision-makers in meaningful commercial conversations.
This is not simply about generating activity or booking meetings. We want our SDRs to understand why they are targeting an organisation, who they should be speaking to and what could create a genuine opportunity for Techary.
You do not need previous enterprise or technology sales experience. We will provide structured training, tools, coaching and hands-on exposure to help you develop. What matters most is your ambition, resilience, curiosity, coachability and confidence to start conversations with new people.
You will join alongside other SDRs as part of our January 2027 intake, developing together while building your own pipeline, target accounts and commercial experience.
For the right person, this is the starting point for a long-term career in technology sales, with a clear progression path from Sales Development Representative to Associate Account Manager and ultimately Account Manager.
### ### Key Responsibilities:
* Proactively identify and engage prospective customers through cold calling, email, networking and events.
* Research high-value target organisations and identify potential opportunities for Techary.
* Build an understanding of target accounts, including their business, technology environment, key stakeholders and potential challenges.
* Identify and engage relevant decision-makers and senior stakeholders.
* Generate qualified new business meetings and opportunities through a thoughtful, multi-channel prospecting approach.
* Conduct initial conversations with prospects to understand their environment, challenges and potential requirements.
* Qualify opportunities to establish whether there is a genuine commercial fit for Techary.
* Develop a strong understanding of Techary’s services, solutions, partners and value proposition.
* Work closely with Account Managers and the wider sales team on target accounts, messaging and new business priorities.
* Maintain accurate records of activity, conversations and opportunities within Salesforce.
* Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team targets.
* Take an active role in sales training, call coaching, roleplays and development sessions.
* Represent Techary professionally when engaging prospective customers.
### ### What You Will Learn
We want this role to be about much more than learning how to book meetings.
You will receive structured development designed to give you the foundations for a successful career in enterprise technology sales, including how to:
* Research and understand complex organisations and their technology environments.
* Break into enterprise accounts and identify the right stakeholders.
* Cold call confidently and create conversations from scratch.
* Write effective and personalised prospecting emails.
* Run structured discovery conversations and ask effective commercial questions.
* Understand customer challenges and identify genuine sales opportunities.
* Qualify opportunities using recognised sales methodologies and frameworks.
* Build a working knowledge of Techary’s technology solutions and services.
* Understand how opportunities progress through a complete B2B sales cycle.
* Develop commercial awareness around pricing, margin and opportunity value.
* Use Salesforce, Lusha, power diallers and other sales tools effectively.
* Communicate confidently with senior decision-makers.
As your experience develops, you will gain increasing exposure to customer meetings, discovery and the wider sales process.
### What We Are Looking For
We are not looking for someone who already knows everything about technology or enterprise sales. We are looking for people with the attitude, ambition and potential to become successful salespeople.
You should have:
* A genuine desire to build a successful career in B2B sales.
* Ambition and motivation to progress.
* Confidence speaking with new people and starting conversations.
* A proactive and resilient mindset.
* Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how businesses operate.
* The ability to take feedback, respond to coaching and continuously improve.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisation and time-management skills.
* The confidence to engage professionally with senior stakeholders.
* A competitive but team-first attitude.
* The drive to take ownership of your own performance and development.
You could be a graduate starting your career, already working in an entry-level sales role, or coming from a customer-facing environment where you have developed strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Previous sales experience is beneficial, but not essential.
Experience with B2B sales, cold calling, outbound prospecting, CRM platforms or working towards targets would be advantageous, but ultimately we are hiring for potential, attitude and ambition.
### Career Progression
### The SDR role is designed as the starting point of your sales career at Techary:
Sales Development Representative → Associate Account Manager → Account Manager
You will initially focus on prospecting, opening conversations and qualifying opportunities before gaining greater exposure to discovery, customer meetings and opportunity management.
As your skills and performance develop, you will have the opportunity to progress into an Associate Account Manager role and ultimately become an Account Manager, with responsibility for your own customers, pipeline and revenue.
Progression is not simply based on time served. It is based on performance, development and demonstrating that you are ready to take on the next level of responsibility.
### **Why Techary?**
Techary is a global technology business giving you the opportunity to work across a wide variety of customers, technologies and projects.
You will learn alongside experienced salespeople and technology specialists while gaining exposure to global partners and customers ranging from growing businesses to large, complex enterprise organisations.
We want people who are ambitious and want to develop quickly. You will be encouraged to ask questions, take ownership, challenge yourself and progressively take on greater commercial responsibility.
At Techary, we also embrace a family culture and believe in working as a team to overcome the challenges we face.
### ### **Benefits**
At Techary, we embrace a family culture and believe in working as a team to overcome any challenge we face.

* Your birthday as an additional day of holiday.
* Social events throughout the year.

* Clear opportunities for career development and progression.

As our **Head of Implementation**, you will build the foundations that let implementation scale: the operating model, the process and the standards we need to grow well beyond where we are today. * **Transform how we implement enterprise customers**: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. * Lead the fundraising campaign for a future Dementia Research Leader, including donor planning, materials, updates and new funding opportunities.

* Help organise opportunities for supporters to engage with our work, including project visits, researcher meetings and Society events.

Are you someone who enjoys building relationships and turning a good opportunity into meaningful support?
You’ll ideally have experience in fundraising, with some understanding of trusts and foundations. You’ll understand what motivates different funders and enjoy finding opportunities that connect their priorities with work that matters.
Do you enjoy writing, influencing and finding the right way to bring people into a cause?
You’ll be a confident communicator who can build positive relationships with colleagues and external stakeholders. You’ll be curious, organised and motivated by the difference your fundraising can make.
You might be a great fit for this role if you:
* Have fundraising experience, ideally including trusts and foundations.
* Understand how trusts and foundations operate and what motivates them to give.
* Enjoy building and stewarding relationships with external organisations.

GB - United Kingdom

As the Lead, Debt Planning & Management you will play a crucial role in the team in developing and executing Tide’s funding strategy both across corporate debt and warehouse funding facilities. **Warehouse funding**

* Lead negotiations for new warehouse facilities, amendments and renewals
* Work closely with lending and finance to ensure facilities remain aligned to portfolio performance
* Monitor advance rates, utilisation, borrowing base availability and concentration limits
* Support the development of future funding structures
**Debt Portfolio Management**
* Monitor all debt facilities throughout their lifecycle
* Manage debt drawdowns, repayments and utilisation planning
* Maintain an accurate forward funding plan

* Partner with the Lead, Liquidity, Forecasting & Risk to incorporate funding assumptions into liquidity forecasts
* Model future debt requirements under multiple business growth scenarios

* Support Board papers relating to funding strategy
**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as Treasury’s primary relationship manager for external lenders and funding partners
* Partner closely with Finance Legal, Risk and Lending teams during transactions
* Support lender due diligence processes
* Present funding recommendations to senior executives

* Ensure compliance with all debt agreements and financing documentation
* Oversea covenant monitoring in partnership with wider Treasury and Finance teas
* Identify emerging funding risks and develop mitigation strategies
* Ensure appropriate governance around debt approvals and funding decisions

**Who we are**
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. .

Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative
**About the job**
This position is needed to play a key role in further growing Twilio’s social impact organization. As our Digital Inside Sales Representative, you will be responsible for lead qualification, net new customer acquisition, solution selling, and closing deals within our self-service accounts, while upholding the Twilio Magic and driving forward with the ultimate goal to help our customers do good.
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you’ll:
* Be responsible for net new customer acquisition, managing an entire sales cycles to drive new revenue while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction for accounts across community & social services, healthcare, traditional NGO’s, Humanitarian aid, Credit Union and other miscellaneous non-profit customers.
* Work with customers to understand their business and technical requirements. You will need to understand the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform so that, together, you can design a solution for their specific use case needs.
* Work diligently with cross-functional internal teams (Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Support) to address customer requirements, advise on digital communication strategies, and help customers get started on the Twilio platform.
* Generate and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce through proactive efforts and collaboration with your manager.
* Execute automation strategies to serve a large quantity of customers while maintaining NPS and preventing churn
* Be an owner to drive deals forward, knock down obstacles for our customers and internally, think outside the box and find the best solution for each customer, and recommend process improvements to support the whole team.
* Develop expertise in the social impact and nonprofit market to help prospective customers understand how others are leveraging Twilio’s platform to scale their reach and missions.
* Have world-class interpersonal and communication skills to make complex technical and financial details sound simple.
* Ability to balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects/deals at the same time.
**Qualifications**
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
**\*Required:**
* At least 1+ years of closing sales experience or sales development/business development experience in a technical SaaS/CPaaS space, with a record of top performance.
* An understanding of (or interest to understand) the cloud computing/communications business model and excitement for selling to a technical audience while utilizing a solution-oriented approach to selling.
* Technical solutions selling experience and enjoys working with real customers - listening to them and solving problems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and financial details sound simple.
* Demonstrated track record of managing forecasts.
* Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.
* World-class organization, prioritization, and documentation skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset.
* Deep personal interest in the social impact market and dedicating your career to making a positive difference.
* High adaptability, with comfort trying new things and building within a rapid-paced environment, comfort with ambiguity and change.
**Location**
This role will be remote, and based in the UK.
**Travel**
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
**What We Offer**
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
**.**
**Stay alert to recruitment fraud**
We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. .
**Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

# Cyber & Information Security Officer
## Forget hacker hunting from a shell; shape how a regulated financial institution thinks about risk. Build a rigorous, automated framework that people actually like.
We usually respond within 2 hours
## About Two
Two builds the decisioning platform behind B2B commerce. Businesses use our SaaS platform for credit decisioning, identity verification and fraud prevention, so they can say yes to more buyers, faster and more safely. We handle over €1Bn annually across Norway, Sweden and the UK; and we're on the path to becoming a licensed credit institution in Sweden.
## The role
We're looking for an Information Security Officer to drive our cyber and data protection programme. You'll own how Two governs information security and personal data across the group — setting the standards, managing the risk, and making sure we can prove it to regulators, clients and auditors.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll work closely with our CTO, senior leadership, business and engineering teams. You will have real influence over how a growing, regulated fintech builds security and privacy into everything it does.
## What you'll do
* Own and evolve our ISMS and security policy framework, aligned to ISO 27001 and DORA
* Run cyber and information risk management, from risk assessments to board-level reporting
* Lead third-party and ICT supplier risk — tiering, due diligence, DPAs and ongoing review
* Lead our EEA-EU GDPR / UK GDPR programme: records of processing, DPIAs, privacy notices, data subject requests and international transfers
* Assess incidents and personal data breaches, and act as our point of contact with data protection authorities
* Shape the ICT and security side of our Swedish credit institution licence
* Answer client security and privacy due diligence with confidence
* Run our security and privacy awareness programme for all staff
## What you'll bring
* Solid experience in information security GRC and/or data protection, ideally in fintech, payments or financial services
* Practical experience building or running an ISMS (ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar)
* Strong working knowledge of GDPR / UK GDPR — not just the theory, but how to make it work day to day
* Familiarity with DORA or EBA ICT risk guidelines
* Enough technical depth in cloud environments (GCP a plus) to challenge engineers credibly
* Clear, sharp writing — equally at home drafting a regulator letter, a board update or a Slack message
* The confidence to work independently and the judgement to focus on what genuinely reduces risk
## Nice to have
* CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CIPP/E or CIPM
* Experience supporting a banking or payments licence application
* PCI DSS, KYC/KYB or fraud-prevention data experience
## What we offer
This is a rare opportunity to take a young fintech from startup to regulated scale-up, laying the policy foundations for our future as a fully operational bank. You'll shape the ICT and security side of Two becoming a licensed credit institution, and you'll deal directly with the regulators as you do it.
**Solid foundations with a real mandate.** You'll not start from scratch. Our policy framework, vendor register and training programme already exist. We need someone to take them from good to great.
**A seat at the table.** You'll work directly with our CTO and leadership team. Your judgement will guide the company’s future growth.
**Modern ways of working.** We run cloud-native on Google Cloud and use AI tools every day. You’ll help us to move fast, safely.
***Apply now - and start the journey today!***

# Executive Director of Environmental Data, Innovation and Growth
Swindon, Wiltshire, United Kingdom
(Hybrid)
## Job Info

## Job Description
**SALARY:** £97,304 - £110,000 Per Annum **HOURS:**Full Time or Part Time (Minimum 0.8 FTE) **CONTRACT TYPE:** Open Ended (Secondees and transfers welcome from universities and research centres or institutes where relevant, minimum duration 3 years) **LOCATION:** Primary base at Polaris House, Swindon with options for other locations (subject to business requirements), with hybrid working as well as frequent travel for key meetings **GRADE:** UKRI Band X **POSITIONS AVAILABLE:** 1 **CLOSING DATE:** Tuesday 3rd November 2026 (23.59pm)
**UKRI RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CLOSE OUR ADVERTS EARLY WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE.**
**ABOUT NERC**
The Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) funds environmental science that is ambitious, creative, and transformative. We have nurtured and curated the environmental science base in the UK for over 60 years since our foundation in 1965. We invest in the research, people, skills, infrastructure and data needed to ensure the UK remains at the forefront of environmental science and innovation on the global stage.
NERC’s science spans the entire earth system from the atmosphere to the biosphere, hydrosphere, sub-surface, oceanic and the polar regions. We fund curiosity-driven research and strategic R&I across universities and national research organisations often in partnership with government departments and national and international stakeholders. Our sustained funding of six NERC research centres provides the ‘national capability’ foundations for the UK environmental science endeavour making long-term and large-scale observing and modelling possible through investment in major research infrastructures (including research stations in polar regions, a fleet of Royal Research Ships and aircraft, and satellite technologies and monitoring stations), which provide the UK with world class expertise and data in critical science areas. We ensure our data assets from our investments are widely accessible in the form of the NERC Environmental Data Service (EDS) which holds over 25 terabytes of data across more than 16,000 distinct datasets. We have ambition to considerably enhance this and develop new applications and markets including through Environmental Data Research UK. In this way we can do much more to secure the UK’s global leadership on climate resilience by leveraging these assets to support sustainable economic growth through a harmonised data, digital and commercial approach. Consequently, this role is designed to capitalise on the goals of the UKRI strategy to ensure the entire organisation of over 9,000 people is more agile and responsive, and work more easily across Councils, Innovate UK and Research England, to make best use of our talented people in supporting the UKRI mission and delivering UKRI strategy. For NERC, growing teams that draw together the digital and data function, and the commercialisation function across the whole of the NERC investment portfolio within UKRI is key.
In recent years NERC has consolidated data provision across its Centres in the form of the NERC Environmental Data Service (EDS) - the UK’s central network for environmental data management. It ensures that UK environmental science data is curated, preserved, and made open for long-term reuse in line with FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) principles.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
You will be NERC’s executive leader for environmental data, informing our digital transformation and digital research infrastructure needs, artificial intelligence and the responsible creation of value from these assets as well as other NERC investments.
As a newly created role, the Executive Director of Environmental Data, Innovation and Growth offers a rare opportunity to shape a bold, future-focused agenda for environmental science data, advancing knowledge while accelerating the application of research and innovation to deliver economic and societal benefit. You will have the opportunity to shape the data, inform the digital platforms and initiate our commercialisation portfolio as part of NERC’s new operating model, establishing the organisational capabilities, accountabilities and ways of working needed to deliver the role’s responsibilities.
This is a pivotal leadership role at the heart of NERC and UKRI. You will set and deliver NERC’s strategy and model development for data and digital, aligned with NERC’s scientific priorities and UKRI’s priority programmes. You will harness the opportunities set out in the UKRI strategy for a resilient Digital Research Infrastructure and AI Research and Innovation Strategic Framework. You will be responsible for shaping business development opportunities across the NERC investment portfolio, drawing on the UKRI Chief Development Officer and Innovate UK teams to define commercialisation opportunities from NERC investments.
**OBJECTIVES**
You will establish and embed a new enterprise-wide approach to environmental data, innovation and growth through e.g. commercialisation potential across NERC, maximising the potential of our data assets across all NERC investments. This will require clear accountabilities, effective governance and a joined-up approach to capabilities, investment and ways of working, while protecting the specialist and mission-critical expertise on which environmental science depends.
A core element of the role will be building and leveraging partnerships across UKRI, government, research organisations, industry, philanthropy and international networks. You will use the strength of NERC’s science, data and infrastructure to attract external investment, supporting our research funding investments to enable innovation and create greater public value.
**WAYS OF WORKING**
As a member of the NERC Executive Team, you will work collectively with NERC’s Directors to ensure coherence and optimisation across the full NERC portfolio and to lead NERC through UKRI’s wider transformation.
You will work particularly closely with the Executive Director of Science to ensure that NERC’s research investments generate high-quality, accessible and reusable data, models and analytical tools and that researchers have the skills, platforms and computational capabilities needed for the future.
You will work with NERC’s Chief Operating Officer, who is responsible for the operational lifecycle of NERC’s infrastructure and assets, to ensure that strategic requirements for data and digital capability are translated into sustainable, resilient and effectively managed services and infrastructure, and, commercialisation potential of NERC’s infrastructure and facilities is realised.
You will also work closely with UKRI’s digital, data and technology leadership under the Chief Information Officer and commercialisation offer under the Chief Development Officer to connect NERC’s specialist capabilities with UKRI-wide platforms, services and standards, particularly enabling good data stewardship. You will ensure that NERC’s digital infrastructure is anchored effectively within UKRI’s wider ambitions so that environmental data can be stored, curated and shared efficiently across organisational and disciplinary boundaries.
**MAIN OUTPUTS AND ACTIVITIES**
Reporting directly to the NERC Executive Chair, you will have responsibility for:
**Enterprise strategy and executive leadership**
* Ensuring NERC’s data, digital platform requirements and potential commercial capabilities inform the design and delivery of its research investments, including programme governance, peer review, partnership development, impact generation and evaluation of outcomes.
* Setting and delivering NERC's strategy for data, innovation and transformation, aligned with NERC, UKRI and national research priorities, including the NROs.
* Acting as NERC's executive lead for data innovation and digital needs, ensuring investment and delivery are driven by scientific impact, organisational value and affordability.
* Contributing to the overall leadership, performance, culture and strategic direction of NERC.
**Environmental data leadership and stewardship**
* Working with the Executive Director of Science, ensuring NERC’s investments in long-term observations, environmental models and data services remain scientifically aligned, sustainable and fit for purpose.
* Providing strategic leadership for the stewardship, governance and utilisation of NERC-funded environmental data.
* Establishing an enterprise-wide data and digital function across NERC, BAS and BGS, ensuring this function delivers across the whole of NERC’s investment portfolio.
* Championing responsible, secure and ethical data use.
**Digital research infrastructure and transformation**
* Leading the strategic development of NERC's requirements of UKRI digital research infrastructure and associated transformation programmes.
* Ensuring specialist environmental science capabilities are aligned with wider UKRI digital, data and technology strategies.
* Driving a coherent and sustainable approach to digital platforms, services and computational capabilities.
* Overseeing the delivery, governance and benefits realisation of major data investments.
**Environmental Data for Research UK**
* Leading the future development of Environmental Data for Research UK (EDRUK) within NERC and across UKRI, taking care to build from the effective parts of the existing Environmental Data Service (EDS) so we can move at pace to fully exploit potential new markets and applications.
* Building partnerships and delivery models across UKRI, government and the wider research community.
* Ensuring researchers can effectively discover, access and use environmental data and analytical tools.
**Artificial intelligence for the environment**
* Working with colleagues across UKRI, leading NERC's approach for the responsible use of artificial intelligence.
* Developing investment priorities and partnerships that maximise the value of AI across environmental research and operations.
* Ensuring appropriate governance, ethics, transparency and security arrangements are in place.
**Supporting business development and external investment**
* Leading NERC's approach to business opportunities and external investment related to its science, data and research infrastructure, working closely with UKRI structures to inform delivery.
* Developing external investment, partnerships and innovation opportunities across the NERC investment portfolio.
* Developing investable propositions that can we shaped into commercial pathways with research centres, partners and through UKRI service provision.
**People, capability and culture**
* Leading and developing a high-performing, inclusive and multidisciplinary team.
* Building the environmental data, innovation and transformation capabilities required for the future.
* Providing visible leadership across NERC's wider data and digital community.
* Championing equality, diversity, inclusion and effective organisational change.
**Governance, finance and assurance**
* Holding accountability for assigned budgets, programmes, services and associated benefits.
* Ensuring robust governance, risk management, financial control and value for money across the portfolio.
* Providing high-quality advice and assurance to NERC and UKRI governance bodies.
* Ensuring compliance with relevant policies, delegated authorities and regulatory requirements.
**ASSESSMENT CRITERIA**
We are seeking a dynamic, creative and respected leader who is inspired by the opportunity to shape and fund the future of environmental data science. You will command professional esteem, ideally across public and private sectors, and engage proactively with NERC and UKRI’s diverse science, data and digital communities. You will draw on their expertise to shape future investment priorities and build partnership and leverage opportunities through trusted relationships with senior academic, public-sector, industry and international leaders.
Success will require strategic oversight and the ability to adapt at pace, keeping ahead of emerging scientific priorities and rapidly advancing technological and computational capabilities while supporting teams to deliver at scale.
Candidates will be assessed against the following criteria throughout the recruitment process:
(S) – Assessed at shortlisting
(I) – Assessed at interview
(S&I) – Assessed at shortlisting & interview
* A strong record of setting strategic direction and delivering enterprise-scale data, digital or technology-enabled transformation, creating measurable scientific, organisational, societal or economic value. (S&I)
* Established credibility in environmental science, data-intensive research or a related field, together with a strong understanding of the UK research and innovation landscape and the role of data and digital capability in enabling research outcomes. (S)
* Strong understanding of data ecosystems, digital platforms, computational research infrastructure, interoperability and the opportunities and risks presented by artificial intelligence. (I)
* Proven ability to lead major programmes, organisational change and cross-boundary partnerships, navigate uncertainty and maintain delivery in complex and fast-moving environments. (S&I)
* Strong governance, assurance and risk-management capability across data, cyber security, artificial intelligence, intellectual property, investment and operational resilience. (I)

You will use the latest signal processing, modelling and imaging technology and some of the most advanced high-performance computing facilities in the world to build high-resolution 3D seismic images & models of subsurface geology and rock properties for our clients.

* Technical innovation, creative problem solving and critical thinking

* Management of complex technical projects
* Effective communication and collaboration with team members and clients

Most people who start with Viridien come from outside the earth sciences; we will provide all necessary training in geology and geophysics.

This role is aimed at recent graduates and final-year students with a Bachelors, integrated or postgraduate Masters or PhD in Physics, Geophysics, or Mathematics, or in Earth Sciences, Natural Sciences or Engineering with significant physics content.

* Your ability to communicate technical concepts

VIRTUS Data Centres is a trusted provider of critical digital infrastructure across the UK and Europe. With a strong UK foundation and a rapidly expanding European presence, we design, build, own, and operate resilient, secure, and energy-efficient data centres for some of the world’s leading organisations.

Our ambition is to plan a key role in enabling the next generation of digital infrastructure, delivering sustainable and innovative solutions while living our core values of Care, Helpful, Pride, Reliability, and Dedication.
**Job summary**
The Senior Purchase Ledger Analyst is responsible for the end‐to‐end purchase‐to‐pay process, ensuring robust control over purchase orders and goods receipts. The role acts as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders and suppliers, supporting accurate and timely invoice resolution and contributing to a clean and well‐controlled month‐end close.
In addition, the role supports supplier governance through pre‐qualification, due diligence, and onboarding, ensuring supplier master data is accurate, compliant, and well maintained. The analyst also provides day‐to‐day operational procurement support, promotes adherence to procurement policies and processes, and contributes to continuous improvement and standardisation across the procure‐to‐pay lifecycle through strong cross‐functional collaboration.
**Duties and Responsibilities**
**Purchase Order, GR & Invoice Management**
· Create and maintain purchase orders in the finance system in accordance with approved requisitions and procurement policies.
· Monitor and follow up on outstanding goods receipts to ensure timely and accurate posting.
· Support invoice processing through three way matching (PO, GR, invoice) and resolution of discrepancies.
· Act as a first point of contact for PO, GR, and invoice queries from internal stakeholders and suppliers.
· Support month end close by ensuring accurate cut off, resolution of GR/IR balances, and timely follow up of outstanding items.
· Act as the primary escalation point for challenging PO issues and system-related queries.
**Supplier Pre Qualification & Due Diligence**
· Support supplier pre qualification processes in line with internal governance and compliance requirements.
· Perform supplier due diligence checks, ensuring all required documentation is obtained, reviewed, and appropriately recorded.
· Escalate supplier risks, exceptions, or incomplete documentation in accordance with internal controls.
**Supplier Registration & Onboarding**
· Manage supplier registration and onboarding requests, ensuring supplier master data is complete, accurate, and compliant.
· Maintain the integrity of supplier master data, including ongoing updates and periodic reviews.
· Provide guidance to internal stakeholders and suppliers on onboarding requirements and timelines.
**Operational Procurement Support**
· Provide day to day operational procurement support across the business, including guidance on PO creation and process adherence.
· Support the implementation and ongoing adherence to procurement policies and standard operating procedures.
· Provide guidance, mentoring, and day-to-day support to Purchase Order Admin Analysts and new team members.
· Assist with continuous improvement initiatives across the procure to pay process, including standardisation and documentation.
· Build strong working relationships with Finance, Procurement, and operational teams to enable efficient purchasing activity.
Any other reasonable requests made by the Accounts Payable Manager, Group Financial Controller and/or Head of Financial Reporting and Controls.

**Qualifications:**
Desirable:
· Educated to degree level.
**Experience:**
Essential:
· Strong knowledge and practical experience in usage and development of ERP systems, specifically SAP.
· Experience in a purchase ledger, accounts payable, or procurement support role.
· Strong understanding of purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice matching processes.
· Experience with supplier onboarding and master data management.
· High level of attention to detail with strong organisational skills.
· Confident communicator with the ability to manage internal and external stakeholders.
Desirable:
· Familiarity with data centre sector or other technology/capital intensive businesses advantageous.
· German or Italian language skills
· Understanding of procurement controls and governance frameworks.
· Advanced Excel skills including use of power query for data analysis.
**Skills:**
Essential:
· Proactive, methodical, and solutions focused.
· Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment.
· Strong team player with a customer service mindset.
· Committed to continuous improvement and high standards of accuracy.

## Job Description
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
**Available Locations: London, the UK**
**About the Role:**
As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.
You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results.
****What you’ll do****
* **Responsibilities:**
+ Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution
+ You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks.
+ Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations
+ Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership
+ Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment
+ Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences.
+ Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development
****Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:****
* Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company
* Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions
* Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)
* Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others
* Excellent communication (verbal & written) – able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude
* Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation
**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost.
**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
**1.1.1.1**: We released1.1.1.1to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use – it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal – we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by ourprivacy commitmentand ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

**You're a great fit if you**
✅ **Have backend experience in production:** You’ve built and run services that real users depend on, ideally in a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala).
✅ **Are curious about functional programming:** You like immutable data, strongly typed APIs and code that’s easy to reason about. You don’t need Scala experience; we’ll help you learn it.

✅ **Take ownership:** You drive work from idea to delivery in a fast-paced startup.
✅ **Have a growth mindset:** You’re eager to learn, including parts of the stack you haven’t touched before.

👎 Want to stay strictly in your lane and avoid infrastructure, frontend or unfamiliar parts of the stack.
👎 Want a strict 9–5: this is a hard role at a small, ambitious company. Some weeks are demanding, especially around launches and incidents. If protected fixed hours are a must for you, this isn’t the place.
**What’s it like working at Yonder?**
🏢 **We’re office-first, remote-friendly**
We’re based in our Brick Lane office, complete with a terrace, breakfast, coffee (from a barista), dogs, beer taps and plenty of comfortable space to do your best work. We ask you to come into the office **at least 3 days a week, with everyone coming in on Mondays.**
🤍 **We take a values-led approach**
Our principles are incredibly important to us, so we recommend you check them out here: Our DNA
📚 **We take development really seriously**
We have a pretty structured process for progression, with fortnightly one-on-ones and quarterly peer perspectives. We also take some time at the end of each week to reflect and celebrate what we’ve learned and achieved.
**What’s in it for me?**
Depending on your skill set and what you can bring from day one, you’ll be looking at:
💰 **£**53,578 - 73,163 depending on experience
📈 **£**34,064 - 60,994 stock options
### Plus

⛷ Team-building offsite
❤️‍🩹 Private healthcare with Bupa
🐣 Up to 12 weeks enhanced parental leave after being with Yonder for 1 year

We take the candidate experience really seriously, so we’ve made the process as transparent as possible. We also promise to be super responsive, and will never leave you wondering where you stand for weeks on end.
**Here’s how it works:**
* **Stage 1:** Intro call (45 mins): You will have an initial video call with Harry Jell, our CTO, to find out more about you and to tell you more about us.

* **Stage 4:** Offer If everyone’s happy, we’ll make you an offer to join us - YAY! 🎉 We hope to always give you a decision between each stage within 24 hours (where possible).

* We love closing the feedback loop at Yonder. You can expect specific feedback on our decision from Stage 2 onwards, and you can always ask for more.

* Demonstrate financial awareness when making day to day business decisions.

* You will be carrying out a range of manual handling duties including heavy lifting of manhole covers.
* Experience of understanding where your role fits within a business plan and then developing ways to deliver the outputs.
* Full Driving Licence with less than 6 points.
* IT skills - Competent using MS Office applications and ability to quickly adapt to new systems.
* Experience of working independently.
* Experience of working in a Customer service environment.
**You will also benefit from having:**
* Previous meter reading experience.
* Understanding of household plumbing and water distribution.
* Experience of delivering against challenging business targets.
* Previous experience in a commercially orientated and / or regulated environment.
* Previous experience gained within the water or waste water sectors or within the broader utilities, process or manufacturing industry sectors.
